              <td className="ledger-delivery ledger-multiline">{item.deliveries.map((entry) => <span key={entry.date}>{entry.date}</span>)}</td><td className="ledger-qty ledger-multiline">{item.deliveries.map((entry) => <span key={entry.date}>{entry.qty}<small>{entry.vendor}</small></span>)}</td>
              {regular && <>{days.slice(0, 3).map((day) => <td className={day === 2 ? 'ledger-day selected-day' : 'ledger-day'} key={day}>{item.daily[day] || ''}</td>)}<td className="ledger-return">{item.daily.return || ''}</td>{days.slice(3).map((day) => <td className="ledger-day" key={day}>{item.daily[day] || ''}</td>)}</>}
              {!regular && days.map((day) => <td className={day === 2 ? 'ledger-day selected-day' : 'ledger-day'} key={day}>{item.daily[day] || ''}</td>)}
              <td className={`ledger-ending ${item.ending < 0 ? 'ledger-negative' : ''}`}>{item.ending}</td><td className="ledger-month-total">{item.monthly}</td>{item.weekly.map((count, index) => <td className="ledger-week" key={periodLabels[index]}>{count}</td>)}
            </tr>)}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )
    }
    
    function UserManagementView({ csrfToken }) {
      const [users, setUsers] = useState([])
      const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(null)
      const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState(null)
      const [userFormOpen, setUserFormOpen] = useState(false)
      const [form, setForm] = useState({ fullName: '', username: '', password: '', role: 'pharmacist', isActive: true })
      const [formError, setFormError] = useState('')
      const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('')
      const [loadingUsers, setLoadingUsers] = useState(true)
      const [savingUser, setSavingUser] = useState(false)
    
      async function loadUsers() {
        setLoadingUsers(true)
        setLoadError('')
        try {
          const result = await requestJson('/api/users/index.php')
          setUsers(result.users || [])
        } catch (error) {
          setLoadError(error.message || 'Could not load users.')
        } finally {
          setLoadingUsers(false)
        }
      }
    
      useEffect(() => {
        loadUsers()
      }, [])
    
      function openForm(user = null) {
        setEditingUser(user)
        setUserFormOpen(true)
        setForm(user
          ? { fullName: user.fullName, username: user.username, password: '', role: user.role, isActive: user.isActive }
          : { fullName: '', username: '', password: '', role: 'pharmacist', isActive: true })
        setFormError('')
      }
    
      async function saveUser(event) {
        event.preventDefault()
        setFormError('')
        if (!form.fullName.trim() || !form.username.trim()) {
          setFormError('Enter the userâ€™s full name and username.')
          return
        }
        if ((!editingUser || form.password) && form.password.length < 8) {
          setFormError('Password must be at least 8 characters.')
          return
        }
    
        setSavingUser(true)
        try {
          const payload = { fullName: form.fullName.trim(), username: form.username.trim(), role: form.role, isActive: form.isActive }
          if (form.password) payload.password = form.password
          const result = await requestJson(editingUser ? '/api/users/update.php' : '/api/users/create.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken },
            body: JSON.stringify(editingUser ? { ...payload, id: editingUser.id } : payload),
          })
          setUserFormOpen(false)
          if (!editingUser && result.user) setSelectedId(result.user.id)
          await loadUsers()
        } catch (error) {
          setFormError(error.message || 'Could not save the user account.')
        } finally {
          setSavingUser(false)
        }
      }
    
      async function deleteUser(user) {
        if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${user.fullName} (${user.username})?`)) return
        try {
          await requestJson('/api/users/delete.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken },
            body: JSON.stringify({ id: user.id }),
          })
          if (selectedId === user.id) setSelectedId(null)
          await loadUsers()
        } catch (error) {
          setLoadError(error.message || 'Could not delete the user account.')
        }
      }
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content user-management-page">
          <div className="user-page-heading"><div><span className="ledger-kicker">WORKSPACE / USER MANAGEMENT</span><h2>Users and roles</h2><p>Manage staff accounts and their assigned access.</p></div><button className="add-user-button" type="button" onClick={() => openForm()}>ï¼‹ Add user</button></div>
          <div className="user-summary-row"><article><span>ALL USERS</span><strong>{users.length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</strong></article><article><span>ADMINS</span><strong>{users.filter((user) => user.role === 'admin').length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</strong></article><article><span>PHARMACISTS</span><strong>{users.filter((user) => user.role === 'pharmacist').length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</strong></article></div>
          <section className="dashboard-card users-table-card">
            <div className="users-table-heading"><div><h3>Staff accounts</h3><p>Select a row to highlight an account. Passwords are never displayed.</p></div><span className="section-pill">PHARMA_INVENTORY</span></div>
            {loadError && <p className="users-load-error" role="alert">{loadError}</p>}
            <div className="users-table-scroll"><table className="users-table"><thead><tr><th>USER ID</th><th>FULL NAME</th><th>USERNAME</th><th>ROLE</th><th>STATUS</th><th>CREATED AT</th><th className="users-actions-heading">ACTIONS</th></tr></thead><tbody>
              {users.map((user) => <tr key={user.id} className={selectedId === user.id ? 'selected-user-row' : ''} aria-selected={selectedId === user.id} onClick={() => setSelectedId(user.id)} tabIndex="0" onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') setSelectedId(user.id) }}>
                <td className="user-id-cell">{user.id.toString().padStart(3, '0')}</td><td><strong className="user-full-name">{user.fullName}</strong></td><td className="username-cell">{user.username}</td><td><span className={`user-role-badge ${user.role === 'admin' ? 'admin-role' : 'pharmacist-role'}`}>{roleTitle(user.role)}</span></td><td><span className={`user-status ${user.isActive ? 'user-active' : 'user-inactive'}`}><i />{user.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}</span></td><td className="user-created-cell">{user.createdAt ? new Date(user.createdAt.replace(' ', 'T')).toLocaleDateString() : 'â€”'}</td><td><div className="user-row-actions"><button type="button" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); openForm(user) }}>Edit</button><button type="button" className="delete-user-action" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); deleteUser(user) }}>Delete</button></div></td>
              </tr>)}
              {loadingUsers && <tr><td className="users-empty-state" colSpan="7">Loading user accountsâ€¦</td></tr>}
              {!loadingUsers && users.length === 0 && <tr><td className="users-empty-state" colSpan="7">No user accounts found. Add a user to get started.</td></tr>}
            </tbody></table></div>
            <div className="users-table-footer">{selectedId ? `Selected user ID ${selectedId}` : 'Select a user row to highlight it'}<span>Showing {users.length} account{users.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span></div>
          </section>
    
          {userFormOpen && <div className="user-modal-backdrop" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) setUserFormOpen(false) }}>
            <section className="user-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="user-form-title">
              <div className="user-modal-heading"><div><span className="ledger-kicker">USER ACCOUNT</span><h2 id="user-form-title">{editingUser ? 'Edit user' : 'Add user'}</h2></div><button type="button" className="modal-close" aria-label="Close form" onClick={() => setUserFormOpen(false)}>Ã—</button></div>
              <form className="user-form" onSubmit={saveUser}>
                <label>Full name<input autoFocus value={form.fullName} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, fullName: event.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g. Juan Dela Cruz" /></label>
                <label>Username<input autoCapitalize="none" value={form.username} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, username: event.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g. juan.delacruz" /></label>
                <label>{editingUser ? 'New password (optional)' : 'Password'}<input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={form.password} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, password: event.target.value }))} placeholder={editingUser ? 'Leave blank to keep current password' : 'At least 8 characters'} /></label>
                <label>Role<select value={form.role} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, role: event.target.value }))}><option value="admin">Admin</option><option value="pharmacist">Pharmacist</option></select></label>
                <label className="user-active-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={form.isActive} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, isActive: event.target.checked }))} /> Active account</label>
                {formError && <p className="user-form-error" role="alert">{formError}</p>}
                <p className="user-form-note">Passwords are hashed before they are stored. The password is never displayed.</p>
                <div className="user-form-actions"><button type="button" className="cancel-user-button" onClick={() => setUserFormOpen(false)} disabled={savingUser}>Cancel</button><button type="submit" className="add-user-button" disabled={savingUser}>{savingUser ? 'Savingâ€¦' : editingUser ? 'Save changes' : 'Add user'}</button></div>

      }

        setError('')

    export default function App() {

      const [error, setError] = useState('')
      const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false)
    
      async function loadSession() {
        setError('')
        setAuth((current) => ({ ...current, status: 'loading' }))
    
        try {
          const session = await requestJson('/api/auth/session.php')
          setAuth({ status: 'ready', user: session.user, csrfToken: session.csrfToken })
        } catch (requestError) {
          setAuth({ status: 'error', user: null, csrfToken: '' })
          setError(requestError.message || 'Could not connect to the PHP API.')
        }
      }
    
      useEffect(() => {
        let active = true
    
        requestJson('/api/auth/session.php')
          .then((session) => {
            if (active) {
              setAuth({ status: 'ready', user: session.user, csrfToken: session.csrfToken })
            }
          })
          .catch((requestError) => {
            if (active) {
              setAuth({ status: 'error', user: null, csrfToken: '' })
              setError(requestError.message || 'Could not connect to the PHP API.')
            }
          })
    
        return () => {
          active = false
        }
      }, [])
    
      async function handleLogin(event) {
        event.preventDefault()
        setError('')
        setSubmitting(true)
    
        try {
          const result = await requestJson('/api/auth/login.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'X-CSRF-Token': auth.csrfToken,
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
          })
          setAuth({ status: 'ready', user: result.user, csrfToken: result.csrfToken })
          setPassword('')
        } catch (requestError) {
          setError(requestError.message || 'Login failed. Please try again.')
        } finally {
          setSubmitting(false)
        }
      }
    
      async function handleLogout() {
        setError('')
        setSubmitting(true)
    
        try {
          const result = await requestJson('/api/auth/logout.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'X-CSRF-Token': auth.csrfToken },
          })
          try {
            window.sessionStorage.removeItem('pharma-dashboard-section')
          } catch {
            // Ignore storage cleanup failures during sign out.
          }
          setAuth({ status: 'ready', user: null, csrfToken: result.csrfToken })
          setPassword('')
        } catch (requestError) {
          setError(requestError.message || 'Could not sign out. Please try again.')
        } finally {
          setSubmitting(false)
        }
      }
    
      if (auth.status === 'loading') {
        return (
          <main className="page-shell">
            <div className="loading-card" role="status">Connecting to JVGH Pharmacyâ€¦</div>
          </main>
        )
      }
    
      if (auth.user) {
        const roles = auth.user.roles || []
        const isAdmin = roles.includes('admin')
    
        if (isAdmin) {
          return <AdminDashboard user={auth.user} csrfToken={auth.csrfToken} onLogout={handleLogout} submitting={submitting} />
        }
    
        return (
          <main className="page-shell">
            <header className="topbar">
              <a className="brand" href="/" aria-label="JVGH Pharmacy home">
                <span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
                <span>JVGH <strong>PHARMACY</strong></span>
              </a>
              <button className="text-button" type="button" onClick={handleLogout} disabled={submitting}>
                {submitting ? 'Signing outâ€¦' : 'Sign out'}
              </button>
            </header>
    
            <section className="welcome-panel">
              <div className="welcome-copy">
                <p className="eyebrow">PHARMACY INVENTORY SYSTEM</p>
                <h1>Welcome, {auth.user.fullName}</h1>
                <p className="welcome-description">
                  You are signed in. Your account role determines which pharmacy tools you can use.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="role-card">
                <span className="role-card-label">SIGNED IN AS</span>
                <div className="role-list">
                  {roles.map((role) => <span className="role-badge" key={role}>{roleTitle(role)}</span>)}
                </div>
                <p>{auth.user.username}</p>
              </div>
            </section>
    
            <section className="next-step-card">
              <div className="next-step-icon" aria-hidden="true">âœ“</div>
              <div>
                <h2>{isAdmin ? 'Administrator access' : 'Pharmacist access'}</h2>
                <p>
                  {isAdmin
                    ? 'Admin accounts are intended to manage users and the pharmacy system.'
                    : 'Pharmacist accounts are intended to work with inventory and stock cards, without user management.'}
                </p>
                <p className="module-note">Login and role recognition are ready. Inventory and user-management screens are next.</p>
              </div>
            </section>
    
            {error && <p className="form-message form-message-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
          </main>
        )
      }
    
      return (
        <main className="page-shell login-layout">
          <section className="login-intro" aria-label="Pharmacy inventory system">
            <a className="brand" href="/" aria-label="JVGH Pharmacy home">
              <span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">+</span>
              <span>JVGH <strong>PHARMACY</strong></span>
            </a>
            <div className="intro-copy">
              <p className="eyebrow">PHARMACY INVENTORY SYSTEM</p>
              <h1>Better visibility for every stock movement.</h1>
              <p>Sign in to continue to the pharmacy inventory workspace.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="intro-footer">Secure access for authorized pharmacy staff</div>
          </section>
    
          <section className="login-panel">
            <div className="login-heading">
              <p className="eyebrow">WELCOME BACK</p>
              <h2>Sign in to your account</h2>
              <p>Use the username and password assigned to you.</p>
            </div>
    
            {error && <p className="form-message form-message-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    
            {auth.status === 'error' && (
              <button className="text-button retry-button" type="button" onClick={loadSession}>
                Retry connection
              </button>
            )}
    
            <form className="login-form" onSubmit={handleLogin}>
              <label htmlFor="username">Username</label>
              <input
                id="username"
                name="username"
                type="text"
                autoComplete="username"
                autoCapitalize="none"
                required
                value={username}
                onChange={(event) => setUsername(event.target.value)}
              />
    
              <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>
              <input
                id="password"
                name="password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
              />
    
              <button className="submit-button" type="submit" disabled={submitting || !auth.csrfToken}>
                {submitting ? 'Signing inâ€¦' : 'Sign in'}
              </button>
            </form>
    
            <p className="login-note">Access is managed by your pharmacy system administrator.</p>
          </section>
        </main>
      )
    }

const [stockYear, stockMonthNumber] = stockMonth.split("-").map(Number);

      const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(null)
      const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState(null)
      const [userFormOpen, setUserFormOpen] = useState(false)
      const [form, setForm] = useState({ fullName: '', username: '', password: '', role: 'pharmacist', isActive: true })
      const [formError, setFormError] = useState('')
      const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState('')
      const [loadingUsers, setLoadingUsers] = useState(true)
      const [savingUser, setSavingUser] = useState(false)
    
      async function loadUsers() {
        setLoadingUsers(true)
        setLoadError('')
        try {
          const result = await requestJson('/api/users/index.php')
          setUsers(result.users || [])
        } catch (error) {
          setLoadError(error.message || 'Could not load users.')
        } finally {
          setLoadingUsers(false)
        }
      }
    
      useEffect(() => {
        loadUsers()
      }, [])
    
      function openForm(user = null) {
        setEditingUser(user)
        setUserFormOpen(true)
        setForm(user
          ? { fullName: user.fullName, username: user.username, password: '', role: user.role, isActive: user.isActive }
          : { fullName: '', username: '', password: '', role: 'pharmacist', isActive: true })
        setFormError('')
      }
    
      async function saveUser(event) {
        event.preventDefault()
        setFormError('')
        if (!form.fullName.trim() || !form.username.trim()) {
          setFormError('Enter the userâ€™s full name and username.')
          return
        }
        if ((!editingUser || form.password) && form.password.length < 8) {
          setFormError('Password must be at least 8 characters.')
          return
        }
    
        setSavingUser(true)
        try {
          const payload = { fullName: form.fullName.trim(), username: form.username.trim(), role: form.role, isActive: form.isActive }
          if (form.password) payload.password = form.password
          const result = await requestJson(editingUser ? '/api/users/update.php' : '/api/users/create.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken },
            body: JSON.stringify(editingUser ? { ...payload, id: editingUser.id } : payload),
          })
          setUserFormOpen(false)
          if (!editingUser && result.user) setSelectedId(result.user.id)
          await loadUsers()
        } catch (error) {
          setFormError(error.message || 'Could not save the user account.')
        } finally {
          setSavingUser(false)
        }
      }
    
      async function deleteUser(user) {
        if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${user.fullName} (${user.username})?`)) return
        try {
          await requestJson('/api/users/delete.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken },
            body: JSON.stringify({ id: user.id }),
          })
          if (selectedId === user.id) setSelectedId(null)
          await loadUsers()
        } catch (error) {
          setLoadError(error.message || 'Could not delete the user account.')
        }
      }
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content user-management-page">
          <div className="user-page-heading"><div><span className="ledger-kicker">WORKSPACE / USER MANAGEMENT</span><h2>Users and roles</h2><p>Manage staff accounts and their assigned access.</p></div><button className="add-user-button" type="button" onClick={() => openForm()}>ï¼‹ Add user</button></div>
          <div className="user-summary-row"><article><span>ALL USERS</span><strong>{users.length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</strong></article><article><span>ADMINS</span><strong>{users.filter((user) => user.role === 'admin').length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</strong></article><article><span>PHARMACISTS</span><strong>{users.filter((user) => user.role === 'pharmacist').length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</strong></article></div>
          <section className="dashboard-card users-table-card">
            <div className="users-table-heading"><div><h3>Staff accounts</h3><p>Select a row to highlight an account. Passwords are never displayed.</p></div><span className="section-pill">PHARMA_INVENTORY</span></div>
            {loadError && <p className="users-load-error" role="alert">{loadError}</p>}
            <div className="users-table-scroll"><table className="users-table"><thead><tr><th>USER ID</th><th>FULL NAME</th><th>USERNAME</th><th>ROLE</th><th>STATUS</th><th>CREATED AT</th><th className="users-actions-heading">ACTIONS</th></tr></thead><tbody>
              {users.map((user) => <tr key={user.id} className={selectedId === user.id ? 'selected-user-row' : ''} aria-selected={selectedId === user.id} onClick={() => setSelectedId(user.id)} tabIndex="0" onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') setSelectedId(user.id) }}>
                <td className="user-id-cell">{user.id.toString().padStart(3, '0')}</td><td><strong className="user-full-name">{user.fullName}</strong></td><td className="username-cell">{user.username}</td><td><span className={`user-role-badge ${user.role === 'admin' ? 'admin-role' : 'pharmacist-role'}`}>{roleTitle(user.role)}</span></td><td><span className={`user-status ${user.isActive ? 'user-active' : 'user-inactive'}`}><i />{user.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}</span></td><td className="user-created-cell">{user.createdAt ? new Date(user.createdAt.replace(' ', 'T')).toLocaleDateString() : 'â€”'}</td><td><div className="user-row-actions"><button type="button" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); openForm(user) }}>Edit</button><button type="button" className="delete-user-action" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); deleteUser(user) }}>Delete</button></div></td>
              </tr>)}
              {loadingUsers && <tr><td className="users-empty-state" colSpan="7">Loading user accountsâ€¦</td></tr>}
              {!loadingUsers && users.length === 0 && <tr><td className="users-empty-state" colSpan="7">No user accounts found. Add a user to get started.</td></tr>}
            </tbody></table></div>
            <div className="users-table-footer">{selectedId ? `Selected user ID ${selectedId}` : 'Select a user row to highlight it'}<span>Showing {users.length} account{users.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span></div>
          </section>
    
          {userFormOpen && <div className="user-modal-backdrop" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) setUserFormOpen(false) }}>
            <section className="user-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="user-form-title">
              <div className="user-modal-heading"><div><span className="ledger-kicker">USER ACCOUNT</span><h2 id="user-form-title">{editingUser ? 'Edit user' : 'Add user'}</h2></div><button type="button" className="modal-close" aria-label="Close form" onClick={() => setUserFormOpen(false)}>Ã—</button></div>
              <form className="user-form" onSubmit={saveUser}>
                <label>Full name<input autoFocus value={form.fullName} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, fullName: event.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g. Juan Dela Cruz" /></label>
                <label>Username<input autoCapitalize="none" value={form.username} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, username: event.target.value }))} placeholder="e.g. juan.delacruz" /></label>
                <label>{editingUser ? 'New password (optional)' : 'Password'}<input type="password" autoComplete="new-password" value={form.password} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, password: event.target.value }))} placeholder={editingUser ? 'Leave blank to keep current password' : 'At least 8 characters'} /></label>
                <label>Role<select value={form.role} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, role: event.target.value }))}><option value="admin">Admin</option><option value="pharmacist">Pharmacist</option></select></label>
                <label className="user-active-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={form.isActive} onChange={(event) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, isActive: event.target.checked }))} /> Active account</label>
                {formError && <p className="user-form-error" role="alert">{formError}</p>}
                <p className="user-form-note">Passwords are hashed before they are stored. The password is never displayed.</p>
                <div className="user-form-actions"><button type="button" className="cancel-user-button" onClick={() => setUserFormOpen(false)} disabled={savingUser}>Cancel</button><button type="submit" className="add-user-button" disabled={savingUser}>{savingUser ? 'Savingâ€¦' : editingUser ? 'Save changes' : 'Add user'}</button></div>
              </form>
            </section>
          </div>}
        </div>

    function getSavedDashboardSection() {
      const pathSection = window.location.pathname
        .split("/")
        .filter(Boolean)
        .at(-1);
      if (pathSection === "dashboard") return "overview";
      if (dashboardSectionKeys.includes(pathSection)) return pathSection;
    
      const hashSection = window.location.hash.slice(1);
      if (dashboardSectionKeys.includes(hashSection)) return hashSection;
      if (["reports", "activity", "team"].includes(hashSection)) return "overview";
    
      try {
        const savedSection = window.sessionStorage.getItem(
          "pharma-dashboard-section",
        );
        return dashboardSectionKeys.includes(savedSection)
          ? savedSection
          : "overview";
      } catch {
        return "overview";
      }
    }

    const weeklyRanges = ['1-7', '8-14', '15-21', '22-28', '29-30']
    
    export default function RegularInventory({ stockMonth, onStockMonthChange }) {
      const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
      const [unitFilter, setUnitFilter] = useState('all')
      const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all')
      const [sort, setSort] = useState('default')
      const [year, monthNumber] = stockMonth.split('-').map(Number)
      const monthLabel = new Date(year, monthNumber - 1, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })
      const units = [...new Set(sampleRegularRows.map((item) => item.unit).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      const categories = [...new Set(sampleRegularRows.map((item) => item.category).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      const visibleRows = sampleRegularRows
        .filter((item) => item.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()))
        .filter((item) => unitFilter === 'all' || item.unit === unitFilter)
        .filter((item) => categoryFilter === 'all' || item.category === categoryFilter)
        .sort((a, b) => sort === 'default' ? 0 : sort === 'az' ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : b.name.localeCompare(a.name))
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content">
          <section className="dashboard-card regular-ledger-card" id="regular">
            <div className="ledger-heading">
              <div><span className="ledger-kicker">E-STOCK / REGULAR</span><h2>Regular inventory</h2><p>Monthly stock card Â· {monthLabel}</p></div>
              <div className="ledger-actions"><span className="sample-indicator"><i /> Sample data</span><MonthYearPicker value={stockMonth} onChange={onStockMonthChange} /></div>
            </div>
            <div className="regular-tools" role="search" aria-label="Filter Regular inventory items">
              <label className="regular-search"><span className="sr-only">Search Items</span><SearchIcon /><input type="search" placeholder="Search Items" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} /></label>
              <label className="regular-select"><span>Unit of Measure</span><select value={unitFilter} onChange={(event) => setUnitFilter(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All units</option>{units.map((unit) => <option key={unit} value={unit}>{unit}</option>)}</select></label>
              <label className="regular-select"><span>Category</span><select value={categoryFilter} onChange={(event) => setCategoryFilter(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All categories</option>{categories.map((category) => <option key={category} value={category}>{category}</option>)}</select></label>
              <div className="regular-sort"><span>Sort items</span><div><button type="button" className={sort === 'az' ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={sort === 'az'} onClick={() => setSort('az')}>A to Z</button><button type="button" className={sort === 'za' ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={sort === 'za'} onClick={() => setSort('za')}>Z to A</button></div></div>
            </div>
            <div className="ledger-hint"><span>â†”</span> Swipe or scroll horizontally to view all stock-card columns</div>
            {visibleRows.length === 0 && <p className="regular-empty-results">No items match your search or filters.</p>}
            <MonthlyStockCard rows={visibleRows} periodLabels={weeklyRanges} regular monthLabel={monthLabel} />
          </section>
        </div>
      )
    }
    
    function SearchIcon() {
      return <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8.7" cy="8.7" r="5.7" /><path d="m13 13 4 4" /></svg>
    }
    .regular-tools { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(190px, 1.35fr) minmax(145px, .8fr) minmax(180px, 1fr) auto; align-items: end; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 18px; border-top: 1px solid #edf1ee; background: #fff; }
    .regular-search, .regular-select { min-width: 0; height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #dfe7e2; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #75847b; }
    .regular-search:focus-within, .regular-select:focus-within { border-color: #8db49a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(76, 137, 96, .1); }
    .regular-search svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: 0 0 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.7; }
    .regular-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #344a3b; font: inherit; font-size: 11px; }
    .regular-search input::placeholder { color: #98a49c; }
    .regular-search input::-webkit-search-cancel-button { cursor: pointer; }
    .regular-select { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; align-content: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px 10px; }
    .regular-select > span, .regular-sort > span { color: #8a968e; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .regular-select select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0 15px 0 0; overflow: hidden; border: 0; outline: 0; appearance: none; background: transparent; color: #405449; font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; text-overflow: ellipsis; cursor: pointer; }
    .regular-select::after { position: absolute; right: 11px; bottom: 10px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-right: 1px solid #74877a; border-bottom: 1px solid #74877a; content: ''; pointer-events: none; transform: rotate(45deg); }
    .regular-sort { display: grid; gap: 5px; }

    .regular-sort button:hover { border-color: #bfd4c5; background: #f8fbf8; }
    .regular-sort button.active { border-color: #b9d5c1; background: #edf6ef; color: #236342; font-weight: 700; }
    .regular-empty-results { margin: 0; padding: 18px; border-top: 1px solid #edf1ee; color: #78877e; font-size: 11px; text-align: center; }

    export default function MonthlyStockCard({ rows, periodLabels, regular = false, monthLabel = 'November 2026' }) {
      const days = Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, index) => index + 1)
      return (
        <div className="ledger-scroll" role="region" aria-label={`${regular ? 'Regular' : 'Donation'} inventory monthly stock card, scroll horizontally to view all columns`} tabIndex="0">

            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-num sticky-num">#</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-item sticky-item">ITEMS</th>
                {regular && <><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-unit">UNIT OF<br />MEASURE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-price">UNIT<br />PRICE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-price">DPRI<br />PRICE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-category">CATEGORY</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-other">OTHER CATEGORY<br />(MOBCHA, YAKAP)</th></>}
                <th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-expiry">EXPIRY<br />DATE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-lot">LOT<br />NUMBER</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-beginning">BEGINNING<br />BALANCE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-delivery">DELIVERY<br />DATE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-qty">QTY<br />DELIVERED</th>
                <th colSpan={regular ? 32 : 31} className="ledger-month">{monthLabel.toUpperCase()}</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-ending">ENDING<br />BALANCE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-month-total">MONTHLY<br />CONSUMPTION</th><th colSpan="5" className="ledger-week-group">WEEKLY CONSUMPTION</th>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                {(regular ? days.slice(0, 3) : days).map((day) => <th className={day === 2 ? 'ledger-day selected-day' : 'ledger-day'} key={day}>{day}</th>)}
                {regular && <th className="ledger-return">SL<br />RET</th>}
                {regular && days.slice(3).map((day) => <th className="ledger-day" key={day}>{day}</th>)}
                {periodLabels.map((range) => <th className="ledger-week" key={range}>{range}</th>)}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>{rows.map((item) => <tr key={item.no}>
              <td className="ledger-num sticky-num">{item.no}</td><td className="ledger-item sticky-item">{item.name}</td>
              {regular && <><td className="ledger-unit">{item.unit}</td><td className="ledger-price">{item.price}</td><td className="ledger-price">{item.dpri}</td><td className="ledger-category">{item.category}</td><td className="ledger-other">{item.other}</td></>}
              <td className="ledger-expiry">{item.expiry}</td><td className="ledger-lot">{item.lot}</td><td className="ledger-beginning">{item.beginning}</td>
              <td className="ledger-delivery ledger-multiline">{item.deliveries.map((entry) => <span key={entry.date}>{entry.date}</span>)}</td><td className="ledger-qty ledger-multiline">{item.deliveries.map((entry) => <span key={entry.date}>{entry.qty}<small>{entry.vendor}</small></span>)}</td>
              {regular && <>{days.slice(0, 3).map((day) => <td className={day === 2 ? 'ledger-day selected-day' : 'ledger-day'} key={day}>{item.daily[day] || ''}</td>)}<td className="ledger-return">{item.daily.return || ''}</td>{days.slice(3).map((day) => <td className="ledger-day" key={day}>{item.daily[day] || ''}</td>)}</>}
              {!regular && days.map((day) => <td className={day === 2 ? 'ledger-day selected-day' : 'ledger-day'} key={day}>{item.daily[day] || ''}</td>)}
              <td className={`ledger-ending ${item.ending < 0 ? 'ledger-negative' : ''}`}>{item.ending}</td><td className="ledger-month-total">{item.monthly}</td>{item.weekly.map((count, index) => <td className="ledger-week" key={periodLabels[index]}>{count}</td>)}
            </tr>)}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )
    }
    
    
    
      async function loadUsers() {
        setLoadingUsers(true)
        setLoadError('')
        try {
          const result = await requestJson('/api/users/index.php')
          setUsers(result.users || [])
        } catch (error) {
          setLoadError(error.message || 'Could not load users.')
        } finally {
          setLoadingUsers(false)
        }
      }
    
      useEffect(() => {
        loadUsers()
      }, [])
    
      useEffect(() => {
        function syncEditRoute() {
          setRouteEditUserId(getEditUserIdFromPath())
        }
        window.addEventListener('popstate', syncEditRoute)
        return () => window.removeEventListener('popstate', syncEditRoute)
      }, [])
    
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!routeEditUserId) {
          setUserFormOpen(false)
          setEditingUser(null)
          return
        }
        const user = users.find((entry) => String(entry.id) === routeEditUserId)
        if (user) openForm(user)
      }, [routeEditUserId, users])
    
      function openForm(user = null) {
        setEditingUser(user)
        setUserFormOpen(true)
        setForm(user
          ? { fullName: user.fullName, username: user.username, password: '', role: user.role, isActive: user.isActive }
          : { fullName: '', username: '', password: '', role: 'pharmacist', isActive: true })
        setFormError('')
      }
    
      function openEditRoute(user) {
        const userId = String(user.id)
        window.history.pushState(
          { ...(window.history.state || {}), section: 'user-management', editUserId: userId },
          '',
          `/user-management/${encodeURIComponent(userId)}/edit`,
        )
        setRouteEditUserId(userId)
        openForm(user)
      }
    
      function closeForm() {
        if (routeEditUserId) {
          if (window.history.state?.editUserId === routeEditUserId) {
            window.history.back()
          } else {
            window.history.replaceState({ section: 'user-management' }, '', '/user-management')
          }
          setRouteEditUserId(null)
        }
        setUserFormOpen(false)
        setEditingUser(null)
      }
    
      async function saveUser(event) {
        event.preventDefault()
        setFormError('')
        if (!form.fullName.trim() || !form.username.trim()) {
          setFormError('Enter the userâ€™s full name and username.')
          return
        }
        if ((!editingUser || form.password) && form.password.length < 8) {
          setFormError('Password must be at least 8 characters.')
          return
        }
    
        setSavingUser(true)
        try {
          const payload = { fullName: form.fullName.trim(), username: form.username.trim(), role: form.role, isActive: form.isActive }
          if (form.password) payload.password = form.password
          const result = await requestJson(editingUser ? '/api/users/update.php' : '/api/users/create.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken },
            body: JSON.stringify(editingUser ? { ...payload, id: editingUser.id } : payload),
          })
          closeForm()
          if (!editingUser && result.user) setSelectedId(result.user.id)
          await loadUsers()
        } catch (error) {
          setFormError(error.message || 'Could not save the user account.')
        } finally {
          setSavingUser(false)
        }
      }
    
      async function deleteUser(user) {
        if (!window.confirm(`Delete ${user.fullName} (${user.username})?`)) return
        try {
          await requestJson('/api/users/delete.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrfToken },
            body: JSON.stringify({ id: user.id }),
          })
          if (selectedId === user.id) setSelectedId(null)
          await loadUsers()
        } catch (error) {
          setLoadError(error.message || 'Could not delete the user account.')
        }
      }
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content user-management-page">
          <div className="user-page-heading"><div><span className="ledger-kicker">WORKSPACE / USER MANAGEMENT</span><h2>Users and roles</h2><p>Manage staff accounts and their assigned access.</p></div><button className="add-user-button" type="button" onClick={() => openForm()}><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12" /></svg><span>Add user</span></button></div>
          <div className="user-summary-row"><article><span>ALL USERS</span><strong>{users.length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</strong></article><article><span>ADMINS</span><strong>{users.filter((user) => user.role === 'admin').length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</strong></article><article><span>PHARMACISTS</span><strong>{users.filter((user) => user.role === 'pharmacist').length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}</strong></article></div>
          <section className="dashboard-card users-table-card">
            <div className="users-table-heading"><div><h3>Staff accounts</h3><p>Select a row to highlight an account. Passwords are never displayed.</p></div><span className="section-pill">PHARMA_INVENTORY</span></div>
            {loadError && <p className="users-load-error" role="alert">{loadError}</p>}
            <div className="users-table-scroll"><table className="users-table"><thead><tr><th>USER ID</th><th>FULL NAME</th><th>USERNAME</th><th>ROLE</th><th>STATUS</th><th>CREATED AT</th><th className="users-actions-heading">ACTIONS</th></tr></thead><tbody>
              {users.map((user) => <tr key={user.id} className={selectedId === user.id ? 'selected-user-row' : ''} aria-selected={selectedId === user.id} onClick={() => setSelectedId(user.id)} tabIndex="0" onKeyDown={(event) => { if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') setSelectedId(user.id) }}>
                <td className="user-id-cell">{user.id.toString().padStart(3, '0')}</td><td><strong className="user-full-name">{user.fullName}</strong></td><td className="username-cell">{user.username}</td><td><span className={`user-role-badge ${user.role === 'admin' ? 'admin-role' : 'pharmacist-role'}`}>{roleTitle(user.role)}</span></td><td><span className={`user-status ${user.isActive ? 'user-active' : 'user-inactive'}`}><i />{user.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive'}</span></td><td className="user-created-cell">{user.createdAt ? new Date(user.createdAt.replace(' ', 'T')).toLocaleDateString() : 'â€”'}</td><td><div className="user-row-actions"><button type="button" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); openEditRoute(user) }}>Edit</button><button type="button" className="delete-user-action" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); deleteUser(user) }}>Delete</button></div></td>

    const weeklyRanges = ['1-7', '8-14', '15-21', '22-28', '29-30']
    
    export default function RegularInventory({ stockMonth, onStockMonthChange }) {
      const [rows, setRows] = useState(sampleRegularRows)
      const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
      const [unitFilter, setUnitFilter] = useState('all')
      const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all')
      const [sort, setSort] = useState('default')
      const [addItemOpen, setAddItemOpen] = useState(false)
      const [itemForm, setItemForm] = useState({ name: '', unit: '', price: '', dpri: '', category: '', other: '', expiry: '', lot: '', beginning: '', deliveryDate: '', deliveredQty: '', vendor: '' })
      const [year, monthNumber] = stockMonth.split('-').map(Number)
      const monthLabel = new Date(year, monthNumber - 1, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })
      const units = [...new Set(rows.map((item) => item.unit).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      const categories = [...new Set(rows.map((item) => item.category).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      const visibleRows = rows
        .filter((item) => item.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()))
        .filter((item) => unitFilter === 'all' || item.unit === unitFilter)
        .filter((item) => categoryFilter === 'all' || item.category === categoryFilter)
        .sort((a, b) => sort === 'default' ? 0 : sort === 'az' ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : b.name.localeCompare(a.name))
    
      function updateItemForm(event) {
        const { name, value } = event.target
        setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: value }))
      }
    
      function addSampleItem(event) {
        event.preventDefault()
        const beginning = Number(itemForm.beginning) || 0
        const deliveredQty = Number(itemForm.deliveredQty) || 0
        const deliveries = itemForm.deliveryDate || deliveredQty || itemForm.vendor
          ? [{ date: itemForm.deliveryDate || 'â€”', qty: deliveredQty, vendor: itemForm.vendor.trim() }]
          : []
        const newItem = {
          no: Math.max(0, ...rows.map((item) => Number(item.no) || 0)) + 1,
          name: itemForm.name.trim(),
          unit: itemForm.unit.trim(),
          price: itemForm.price ? `â‚±${Number(itemForm.price).toFixed(2)}` : '',
          dpri: itemForm.dpri ? `â‚±${Number(itemForm.dpri).toFixed(2)}` : '',
          category: itemForm.category.trim(),
          other: itemForm.other.trim(),
          expiry: itemForm.expiry.trim(),
          lot: itemForm.lot.trim(),
          beginning,
          deliveries,
          daily: {},
          ending: beginning + deliveredQty,
          monthly: 0,
          weekly: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0],
        }
        setRows((current) => [...current, newItem])
        setSearch('')
        setUnitFilter('all')
        setCategoryFilter('all')
        setSort('default')
        setItemForm({ name: '', unit: '', price: '', dpri: '', category: '', other: '', expiry: '', lot: '', beginning: '', deliveryDate: '', deliveredQty: '', vendor: '' })
        setAddItemOpen(false)
      }
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content">
          <section className="dashboard-card regular-ledger-card" id="regular">
            <div className="ledger-heading">
              <div><span className="ledger-kicker">E-STOCK / REGULAR</span><h2>Regular inventory</h2><p>Monthly stock card Â· {monthLabel}</p></div>
              <div className="ledger-actions"><span className="sample-indicator"><i /> Sample data</span><MonthYearPicker value={stockMonth} onChange={onStockMonthChange} /></div>
            </div>
            <div className="regular-inventory-actions"><span>Sample preview Â· new items stay in this page session</span><button className="regular-add-item-button" type="button" onClick={() => setAddItemOpen(true)}><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12" /></svg>Add item</button></div>
            <div className="regular-tools" role="search" aria-label="Filter Regular inventory items">
              <label className="regular-search"><span className="sr-only">Search Items</span><SearchIcon /><input type="search" placeholder="Search Items" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} /></label>
              <label className="regular-select"><span>Unit of Measure</span><select value={unitFilter} onChange={(event) => setUnitFilter(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All units</option>{units.map((unit) => <option key={unit} value={unit}>{unit}</option>)}</select></label>
              <label className="regular-select"><span>Category</span><select value={categoryFilter} onChange={(event) => setCategoryFilter(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All categories</option>{categories.map((category) => <option key={category} value={category}>{category}</option>)}</select></label>
              <div className="regular-sort"><span>Sort items</span><div><button type="button" className={sort === 'az' ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={sort === 'az'} onClick={() => setSort('az')}>A to Z</button><button type="button" className={sort === 'za' ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={sort === 'za'} onClick={() => setSort('za')}>Z to A</button></div></div>
            </div>
            <div className="ledger-hint"><span>â†”</span> Swipe or scroll horizontally to view all stock-card columns</div>
            {visibleRows.length === 0 && <p className="regular-empty-results">No items match your search or filters.</p>}
            <MonthlyStockCard rows={visibleRows} periodLabels={weeklyRanges} regular monthLabel={monthLabel} />
          </section>
          {addItemOpen && <div className="regular-item-modal-backdrop" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) setAddItemOpen(false) }}>
            <section className="regular-item-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="regular-add-item-title">
              <div className="regular-item-modal-heading"><div><span className="ledger-kicker">E-STOCK / REGULAR Â· SAMPLE</span><h2 id="regular-add-item-title">Add item</h2><p>This preview is not saved to the database.</p></div></div>
              <form className="regular-item-form" onSubmit={addSampleItem}>
                <label className="regular-item-name-field">Item name<input name="name" value={itemForm.name} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="Medicine or supply name" required autoFocus /></label>
                <label>Unit of measure<input name="unit" value={itemForm.unit} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="e.g. tablet, vial" /></label>
                <label>Unit price<input name="price" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value={itemForm.price} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="0.00" /></label>
                <label>DPRI price<input name="dpri" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value={itemForm.dpri} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="0.00" /></label>

                <label>Beginning balance<input name="beginning" type="number" min="0" step="1" value={itemForm.beginning} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="0" /></label>
                <label>Delivery date<input name="deliveryDate" type="date" value={itemForm.deliveryDate} onChange={updateItemForm} /></label>
                <label>Qty delivered<input name="deliveredQty" type="number" min="0" step="1" value={itemForm.deliveredQty} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="0" /></label>
                <label>Supplier<input name="vendor" value={itemForm.vendor} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="Supplier name" /></label>
                <div className="regular-item-form-actions"><button type="button" className="regular-item-cancel" onClick={() => setAddItemOpen(false)}>Cancel</button><button type="submit" className="regular-add-item-button">Add sample item</button></div>

    export default function MonthlyStockCard({ rows, periodLabels, regular = false, monthLabel = 'November 2026', onItemClick }) {
      const days = Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, index) => index + 1)
      return (
        <div className="ledger-scroll" role="region" aria-label={`${regular ? 'Regular' : 'Donation'} inventory monthly stock card, scroll horizontally to view all columns`} tabIndex="0">
          <table className={`ledger-table ${regular ? 'regular-grid-table' : 'donation-grid-table'}`}>
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-num sticky-num">#</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-item sticky-item">ITEMS</th>
                {regular && <><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-unit">UNIT OF<br />MEASURE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-price">UNIT<br />PRICE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-price">DPRI<br />PRICE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-category">CATEGORY</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-other">OTHER CATEGORY<br />(MOBCHA, YAKAP)</th></>}
                <th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-expiry">EXPIRY<br />DATE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-lot">LOT<br />NUMBER</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-beginning">BEGINNING<br />BALANCE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-delivery">DELIVERY<br />DATE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-qty">QTY<br />DELIVERED</th>
                <th colSpan={regular ? 32 : 31} className="ledger-month">{monthLabel.toUpperCase()}</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-ending">ENDING<br />BALANCE</th><th rowSpan="2" className="ledger-month-total">MONTHLY<br />CONSUMPTION</th><th colSpan="5" className="ledger-week-group">WEEKLY CONSUMPTION</th>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                {(regular ? days.slice(0, 3) : days).map((day) => <th className={day === 2 ? 'ledger-day selected-day' : 'ledger-day'} key={day}>{day}</th>)}
                {regular && <th className="ledger-return">SL<br />RET</th>}
                {regular && days.slice(3).map((day) => <th className="ledger-day" key={day}>{day}</th>)}
                {periodLabels.map((range) => <th className="ledger-week" key={range}>{range}</th>)}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>{rows.map((item) => <tr key={item.no}>
              <td className="ledger-num sticky-num">{item.no}</td><td className="ledger-item sticky-item">{onItemClick ? <button className="ledger-item-edit-trigger" type="button" onClick={() => onItemClick(item)}>{item.name}</button> : item.name}</td>
              {regular && <><td className="ledger-unit">{item.unit}</td><td className="ledger-price">{item.price}</td><td className="ledger-price">{item.dpri}</td><td className="ledger-category">{item.category}</td><td className="ledger-other">{item.other}</td></>}
              <td className="ledger-expiry">{item.expiry}</td><td className="ledger-lot">{item.lot}</td><td className="ledger-beginning">{item.beginning}</td>
              <td className="ledger-delivery ledger-multiline">{item.deliveries.map((entry) => <span key={entry.date}>{entry.date}</span>)}</td><td className="ledger-qty ledger-multiline">{item.deliveries.map((entry) => <span key={entry.date}>{entry.qty}<small>{entry.vendor}</small></span>)}</td>
              {regular && <>{days.slice(0, 3).map((day) => <td className={day === 2 ? 'ledger-day selected-day' : 'ledger-day'} key={day}>{item.daily[day] || ''}</td>)}<td className="ledger-return">{item.daily.return || ''}</td>{days.slice(3).map((day) => <td className="ledger-day" key={day}>{item.daily[day] || ''}</td>)}</>}
              {!regular && days.map((day) => <td className={day === 2 ? 'ledger-day selected-day' : 'ledger-day'} key={day}>{item.daily[day] || ''}</td>)}
              <td className={`ledger-ending ${item.ending < 0 ? 'ledger-negative' : ''}`}>{item.ending}</td><td className="ledger-month-total">{item.monthly}</td>{item.weekly.map((count, index) => <td className="ledger-week" key={periodLabels[index]}>{count}</td>)}
            </tr>)}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )
    }

    function toDateInput(value = '') {

## Assistant

Inayos ko ang expiry colors sa Regular: **current year = green**, **next year = red**, at **mga susunod na taon = white**. Hiwalay na ang kulay ng bawat date, kaya kung 2027 at 2028 ang nasa iisang cell, red lang ang 2027 at white ang 2028.

Pumasa ang `npm run build`, at naitala ko ito sa `TASKS_COMPLETED.txt`.

    +function toExpiryDateInput(value = '') {
    +  const fullDate = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
    +  if (fullDate) return `${fullDate[3]}-${fullDate[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${fullDate[2].padStart(2, '0')}`
    +  const monthYear = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
    +  if (monthYear) return `${monthYear[2]}-${monthYear[1].padStart(2, '0')}-01`
    +  return value.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/) ? value : ''
    +}
    +
    +function toExpiryStockValue(value = '') {
    +  const match = value.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/)
    +  if (!match) return value
    +  return match[3] === '01'
    +    ? `${match[2]}/${match[1]}`
    +    : `${Number(match[2])}/${Number(match[3])}/${match[1]}`
    +}

    export default function AdminDashboard({
      user,
      csrfToken,
      onLogout,
      submitting,
    }) {
      const [stockMenuOpen, setStockMenuOpen] = useState(true);
      const [sidebarOpen, setSidebarOpen] = useState(getInitialSidebarOpen);
      const [activeSection, setActiveSection] = useState(getSavedDashboardSection);
      const [stockMonth, setStockMonth] = useState("2026-11");
      const [stockYear, stockMonthNumber] = stockMonth.split("-").map(Number);
      const stockMonthLabel = new Date(
        stockYear,
        stockMonthNumber - 1,
        1,
      ).toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "long", year: "numeric" });
      function navigateToSection(section) {
        setActiveSection(section);
        const route = section === "overview" ? "/dashboard" : `/${section}`;
        window.history.pushState({ section }, "", route);
        if (window.innerWidth <= 760) setSidebarOpen(false);
      }
    
      useEffect(() => {
        const currentRoute =
          activeSection === "overview" ? "/dashboard" : `/${activeSection}`;
        if (window.location.pathname === "/" || window.location.hash) {
          window.history.replaceState({ section: activeSection }, "", currentRoute);
        } else {
          window.history.replaceState(
            { ...window.history.state, section: activeSection },
            "",
          );
        }
    
        function handlePopState(event) {
          const section = dashboardSectionKeys.includes(event.state?.section)
            ? event.state.section
            : getSavedDashboardSection();
          setActiveSection(section);
        }
    
        window.addEventListener("popstate", handlePopState);
        return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", handlePopState);
      }, []);
    
      useEffect(() => {
        try {
          window.sessionStorage.setItem("pharma-dashboard-section", activeSection);
        } catch {
          // Keep navigation usable when browser storage is unavailable.
        }
      }, [activeSection]);
    
      const sectionTitles = {
        overview: "Dashboard",
        regular: "Regular inventory",
        "stock-cards": "Stock Cards",
        donation: "Donation inventory",
        mhmap: "MHMAP inventory",
        "monthly-consumption": "Monthly Consumption",
        inventory: "Inventory",
        "rpci-regular": "RPCI Regular",
        "rpci-donation": "RPCI Donation",
        "user-management": "User Management",
      };
      const sectionTitle = sectionTitles[activeSection] || "Dashboard";
    
      return (
        <main
          className={`dashboard-shell ${sidebarOpen ? "sidebar-open" : "sidebar-closed"}`}
        >
          {sidebarOpen && (
            <button
              className="sidebar-backdrop"
              type="button"
              aria-label="Close navigation"
              onClick={() => setSidebarOpen(false)}
            />
          )}
          <aside
            className={`dashboard-sidebar ${sidebarOpen ? "is-open" : ""}`}
            id="admin-sidebar"
            aria-label="Workspace sidebar"
          >
            <div className="sidebar-brand-row">
              <a
                className="brand dashboard-brand"
                href="/"
                aria-label="JVGH Pharmacy home"
              >
                <span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">
                  +
                </span>
                <span>
                  JVGH <strong>PHARMACY</strong>
                </span>
              </a>
              <button
                className="sidebar-toggle"
                type="button"
                aria-label={
                  sidebarOpen ? "Collapse sidebar to icons" : "Expand sidebar"
                }

    const weeklyRanges = ['1-7', '8-14', '15-21', '22-28', '29-30']

    function toDateInput(value = '') {
      const match = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      return match ? `${match[3]}-${match[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${match[2].padStart(2, '0')}` : value
    }
    
    function toStockCardDate(value = '') {
      const match = value.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/)
      return match ? `${Number(match[2])}/${Number(match[3])}/${match[1]}` : value
    }
    
    function toExpiryDateInput(value = '') {
      const fullDate = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      if (fullDate) return `${fullDate[3]}-${fullDate[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${fullDate[2].padStart(2, '0')}`
      const monthYear = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      if (monthYear) return `${monthYear[2]}-${monthYear[1].padStart(2, '0')}-01`
      return value.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/) ? value : ''
    }
    
    function toExpiryStockValue(value = '') {
      const match = value.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/)
      if (!match) return value
      return match[3] === '01'
        ? `${match[2]}/${match[1]}`
        : `${Number(match[2])}/${Number(match[3])}/${match[1]}`
    }
    
    export default function RegularInventory({ stockMonth, onStockMonthChange }) {
      const [rows, setRows] = useState(sampleRegularRows)
      const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
      const [unitFilter, setUnitFilter] = useState('all')
      const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all')
      const [sort, setSort] = useState('default')
      const [addItemOpen, setAddItemOpen] = useState(false)
      const [editingItemNo, setEditingItemNo] = useState(null)
      const [itemForm, setItemForm] = useState(blankItemForm)
      const [year, monthNumber] = stockMonth.split('-').map(Number)
      const monthLabel = new Date(year, monthNumber - 1, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })
      const units = [...new Set(rows.map((item) => item.unit).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      const categories = [...new Set(rows.map((item) => item.category).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      const visibleRows = rows
        .filter((item) => item.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()))
        .filter((item) => unitFilter === 'all' || item.unit === unitFilter)
        .filter((item) => categoryFilter === 'all' || item.category === categoryFilter)
        .sort((a, b) => sort === 'default' ? 0 : sort === 'az' ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : b.name.localeCompare(a.name))
    
      function updateItemForm(event) {
        const { name, value } = event.target
        setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: value }))
      }
    
      function beginAddItem() {
        setEditingItemNo(null)
        setItemForm(blankItemForm())
        setAddItemOpen(true)
      }
    
      function beginEditItem(item) {
        setEditingItemNo(item.no)
        setItemForm({
          name: item.name || '',
          unit: item.unit || '',
          price: item.price ? item.price.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '') : '',
          dpri: item.dpri ? item.dpri.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '') : '',
          category: item.category || '',
          other: item.other || '',
          expiryDates: String(item.expiry || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean).length
            ? String(item.expiry || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(toExpiryDateInput)
            : [''],
          lot: item.lot || '',
          beginning: item.beginning ?? '',
          deliveries: item.deliveries?.length ? item.deliveries.map((delivery) => ({ date: toDateInput(delivery.date || ''), qty: delivery.qty ?? '', vendor: delivery.vendor || '' })) : [blankDelivery()],
          daily: { ...(item.daily || {}) },
          returnQty: item.daily?.return ?? '',
          ending: item.ending ?? '',
          monthly: item.monthly ?? '',
          weekly: weeklyRanges.map((_, index) => item.weekly?.[index] ?? 0),
        })
        setAddItemOpen(true)
      }
    
      function updateDelivery(index, key, value) {
        setItemForm((current) => ({
          ...current,
          deliveries: current.deliveries.map((delivery, rowIndex) => rowIndex === index ? { ...delivery, [key]: value } : delivery),
        }))
      }
    
      function updateExpiryDate(index, value) {
        setItemForm((current) => ({
          ...current,
          expiryDates: current.expiryDates.map((expiry, rowIndex) => rowIndex === index ? value : expiry),
        }))
      }
    
      function updateDaily(day, value) {
        setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, daily: { ...current.daily, [day]: value } }))
      }
    
      function addSampleItem(event) {
        event.preventDefault()
        const beginning = Number(itemForm.beginning) || 0
        const deliveries = itemForm.deliveries
          .filter((delivery) => delivery.date || delivery.qty || delivery.vendor.trim())
          .map((delivery) => ({ date: toStockCardDate(delivery.date), qty: Number(delivery.qty) || 0, vendor: delivery.vendor.trim() }))
        const deliveredQty = deliveries.reduce((total, delivery) => total + delivery.qty, 0)
        const newItem = {
          no: editingItemNo ?? Math.max(0, ...rows.map((item) => Number(item.no) || 0)) + 1,
          name: itemForm.name.trim(),
          unit: itemForm.unit.trim(),
          price: itemForm.price ? `\u20B1${Number(itemForm.price).toFixed(2)}` : '',
          dpri: itemForm.dpri ? `\u20B1${Number(itemForm.dpri).toFixed(2)}` : '',
          category: itemForm.category.trim(),
          other: itemForm.other.trim(),
          expiry: itemForm.expiryDates.map((expiry) => toExpiryStockValue(expiry.trim())).filter(Boolean).join('\n'),
          lot: itemForm.lot.trim(),
          beginning,
          deliveries,
          daily: { ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(itemForm.daily).map(([day, qty]) => [day, Number(qty) || 0])), return: Number(itemForm.returnQty) || 0 },
          ending: itemForm.ending === '' ? beginning + deliveredQty : Number(itemForm.ending) || 0,
          monthly: Number(itemForm.monthly) || 0,
          weekly: itemForm.weekly.map((qty) => Number(qty) || 0),
        }
        if (editingItemNo !== null) {
          setRows((current) => current.map((item) => item.no === editingItemNo ? newItem : item))
        } else {
          setRows((current) => [...current, newItem])
        }
        setSearch('')
        setUnitFilter('all')
        setCategoryFilter('all')
        setSort('default')
        setItemForm(blankItemForm())
        setEditingItemNo(null)
        setAddItemOpen(false)
      }
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content">
          <section className="dashboard-card regular-ledger-card" id="regular">
            <div className="ledger-heading">
              <div><span className="ledger-kicker">E-STOCK / REGULAR</span><h2>Regular inventory</h2><p>Monthly stock card Â· {monthLabel}</p></div>
              <div className="ledger-actions"><span className="sample-indicator"><i /> Sample data</span><MonthYearPicker value={stockMonth} onChange={onStockMonthChange} /></div>
            </div>
            <div className="regular-inventory-actions"><span>Sample only Â· not saved to database</span><button className="regular-add-item-button" type="button" onClick={beginAddItem}><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12" /></svg>Add item</button></div>
            <div className="regular-tools" role="search" aria-label="Filter Regular inventory items">
              <label className="regular-search"><span className="sr-only">Search Items</span><SearchIcon /><input type="search" placeholder="Search Items" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} /></label>
              <label className="regular-select"><span>Unit of Measure</span><select value={unitFilter} onChange={(event) => setUnitFilter(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All units</option>{units.map((unit) => <option key={unit} value={unit}>{unit}</option>)}</select></label>
              <label className="regular-select"><span>Category</span><select value={categoryFilter} onChange={(event) => setCategoryFilter(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All categories</option>{categories.map((category) => <option key={category} value={category}>{category}</option>)}</select></label>
              <div className="regular-sort"><span>Sort items</span><div><button type="button" className={sort === 'az' ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={sort === 'az'} onClick={() => setSort('az')}>A to Z</button><button type="button" className={sort === 'za' ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={sort === 'za'} onClick={() => setSort('za')}>Z to A</button></div></div>
            </div>

            {visibleRows.length === 0 && <p className="regular-empty-results">No items match your search or filters.</p>}

    function toDateInput(value = '') {
      const match = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      return match ? `${match[3]}-${match[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${match[2].padStart(2, '0')}` : value
    }
    
    function toStockCardDate(value = '') {
      const match = value.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/)
      return match ? `${Number(match[2])}/${Number(match[3])}/${match[1]}` : value
    }
    
    function toExpiryDateInput(value = '') {
      const fullDate = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      if (fullDate) return `${fullDate[3]}-${fullDate[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${fullDate[2].padStart(2, '0')}`
      const monthYear = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      if (monthYear) return `${monthYear[2]}-${monthYear[1].padStart(2, '0')}-01`
      return value.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/) ? value : ''
    }
    
    function toExpiryStockValue(value = '') {
      const match = value.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/)
      if (!match) return value
      return match[3] === '01'
        ? `${match[2]}/${match[1]}`
        : `${Number(match[2])}/${Number(match[3])}/${match[1]}`
    }

      const [sort, setSort] = useState('default')

      const [editingItemNo, setEditingItemNo] = useState(null)
      const [itemForm, setItemForm] = useState(blankItemForm)

      const units = [...new Set(rows.map((item) => item.unit).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      const categories = [...new Set(rows.map((item) => item.category).filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b))
      const visibleRows = rows
        .filter((item) => item.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()))
        .filter((item) => unitFilter === 'all' || item.unit === unitFilter)
        .filter((item) => categoryFilter === 'all' || item.category === categoryFilter)
        .sort((a, b) => sort === 'default' ? 0 : sort === 'az' ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : b.name.localeCompare(a.name))
    
      function updateItemForm(event) {
        const { name, value } = event.target
        setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: value }))
      }
    
      function beginAddItem() {
        setEditingItemNo(null)
        setItemForm(blankItemForm())
        setAddItemOpen(true)
      }
    
      function beginEditItem(item) {
        setEditingItemNo(item.no)
        setItemForm({
          name: item.name || '',
          unit: item.unit || '',
          price: item.price ? item.price.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '') : '',
          dpri: item.dpri ? item.dpri.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '') : '',
          category: item.category || '',
          other: item.other || '',
          expiryDates: String(item.expiry || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean).length
            ? String(item.expiry || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(toExpiryDateInput)
            : [''],
          lot: item.lot || '',
          beginning: item.beginning ?? '',
          deliveries: item.deliveries?.length ? item.deliveries.map((delivery) => ({ date: toDateInput(delivery.date || ''), qty: delivery.qty ?? '', vendor: delivery.vendor || '' })) : [blankDelivery()],
          daily: { ...(item.daily || {}) },
          returnQty: item.daily?.return ?? '',
          ending: item.ending ?? '',
          monthly: item.monthly ?? '',

        })
        setAddItemOpen(true)
      }
    
      function updateDelivery(index, key, value) {

          ...current,
          deliveries: current.deliveries.map((delivery, rowIndex) => rowIndex === index ? { ...delivery, [key]: value } : delivery),
        }))
      }
    
      function updateExpiryDate(index, value) {
        setItemForm((current) => ({
          ...current,
          expiryDates: current.expiryDates.map((expiry, rowIndex) => rowIndex === index ? value : expiry),
        }))
      }
    
      function updateDaily(day, value) {
        setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, daily: { ...current.daily, [day]: value } }))
      }
    
      function addSampleItem(event) {
        event.preventDefault()
        const beginning = Number(itemForm.beginning) || 0
        const deliveries = itemForm.deliveries
          .filter((delivery) => delivery.date || delivery.qty || delivery.vendor.trim())
          .map((delivery) => ({ date: toStockCardDate(delivery.date), qty: Number(delivery.qty) || 0, vendor: delivery.vendor.trim() }))
        const deliveredQty = deliveries.reduce((total, delivery) => total + delivery.qty, 0)
        const newItem = {
          no: editingItemNo ?? Math.max(0, ...rows.map((item) => Number(item.no) || 0)) + 1,
          name: itemForm.name.trim(),
          unit: itemForm.unit.trim(),
          price: itemForm.price ? `\u20B1${Number(itemForm.price).toFixed(2)}` : '',
          dpri: itemForm.dpri ? `\u20B1${Number(itemForm.dpri).toFixed(2)}` : '',
          category: itemForm.category.trim(),
          other: itemForm.other.trim(),
          expiry: itemForm.expiryDates.map((expiry) => toExpiryStockValue(expiry.trim())).filter(Boolean).join('\n'),
          lot: itemForm.lot.trim(),
          beginning,
          deliveries,
          daily: { ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(itemForm.daily).map(([day, qty]) => [day, Number(qty) || 0])), return: Number(itemForm.returnQty) || 0 },
          ending: itemForm.ending === '' ? beginning + deliveredQty : Number(itemForm.ending) || 0,
          monthly: Number(itemForm.monthly) || 0,
          weekly: itemForm.weekly.map((qty) => Number(qty) || 0),
        }
        if (editingItemNo !== null) {
          setRows((current) => current.map((item) => item.no === editingItemNo ? newItem : item))
        } else {
          setRows((current) => [...current, newItem])
        }
        setSearch('')
        setUnitFilter('all')
        setCategoryFilter('all')
        setSort('default')
        setItemForm(blankItemForm())
        setEditingItemNo(null)
        setAddItemOpen(false)
      }

    function toStockCardDate(value = '') {

    function toExpiryDateInput(value = '') {
      const fullDate = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      if (fullDate) return `${fullDate[3]}-${fullDate[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${fullDate[2].padStart(2, '0')}`
      const monthYear = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      if (monthYear) return `${monthYear[2]}-${monthYear[1].padStart(2, '0')}-01`
