    import { useState } from 'react'
    import { defaultRegularDropdownOptions, getRegularDropdownOptions, saveRegularDropdownOptions } from './regularDropdownOptions.js'
    import './RegularDropdownOptions.css'
    
    export default function RegularDropdownOptions() {
      const [options, setOptions] = useState(getRegularDropdownOptions)
      const [newUnit, setNewUnit] = useState('')
      const [newCategory, setNewCategory] = useState('')
      const [notice, setNotice] = useState('')
    
      function updateOptions(next) {
        setOptions(next)
        saveRegularDropdownOptions(next)
      }
    
      function addOption(list, value, reset) {
        const cleaned = value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
        if (!cleaned) return
        if (options[list].some((item) => item.toLocaleLowerCase() === cleaned.toLocaleLowerCase())) {
          setNotice('Nasa list na ang option na iyan.')
          return
        }
        updateOptions({ ...options, [list]: [...options[list], cleaned] })
        reset('')
        setNotice('Naidagdag ang dropdown option.')
      }
    
      function removeOption(list, value) {
        updateOptions({ ...options, [list]: options[list].filter((item) => item !== value) })
        setNotice(`Tinanggal ang “${value}” sa options list.`)
      }
    
      function restoreDefaults() {
        const restored = { units: [...defaultRegularDropdownOptions.units], categories: [...defaultRegularDropdownOptions.categories] }
        updateOptions(restored)
        setNotice('Naibalik ang default options.')
      }
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content regular-options-page">
          <div className="regular-options-intro">
            <div><span className="ledger-kicker">E-STOCK / REGULAR</span><h2>Dropdown options</h2><p>Magdagdag o magtanggal ng choices na lalabas sa Regular inventory forms at filters.</p></div>
            <button className="regular-options-restore" type="button" onClick={restoreDefaults}>Restore defaults</button>
          </div>
          {notice && <p className="regular-options-notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}
          <div className="regular-options-grid">
            <OptionCard title="Unit of Measure" entries={options.units} value={newUnit} onChange={setNewUnit} onAdd={() => addOption('units', newUnit, setNewUnit)} onDelete={(value) => removeOption('units', value)} />
            <OptionCard title="Category" entries={options.categories} value={newCategory} onChange={setNewCategory} onAdd={() => addOption('categories', newCategory, setNewCategory)} onDelete={(value) => removeOption('categories', value)} />
          </div>
          <p className="regular-options-footnote">Sample UI settings · saved in this browser only</p>
        </div>
      )
    }
    
    function OptionCard({ title, entries, value, onChange, onAdd, onDelete }) {
      return (
        <section className="dashboard-card regular-options-card">
          <div className="regular-options-card-heading"><div><h3>{title}</h3><p>{entries.length} dropdown options</p></div><span>{String(entries.length).padStart(2, '0')}</span></div>
          <form className="regular-options-add" onSubmit={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); onAdd() }}>
            <input aria-label={`New ${title}`} value={value} onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)} placeholder={`Add ${title.toLowerCase()}`} />
            <button className="regular-add-item-button" type="submit">+ Add</button>
          </form>
          <ul className="regular-options-list">
            {entries.map((entry) => <li key={entry}><span>{entry}</span><button type="button" onClick={() => onDelete(entry)} aria-label={`Delete ${entry}`}>Delete</button></li>)}
            {entries.length === 0 && <li className="regular-options-empty">No options yet. Add one above.</li>}
          </ul>
        </section>
      )
    }

    export const defaultRegularDropdownOptions = {
      units: ['tablet', 'vial', 'ampule', 'capsule', 'bottle', 'suspension', 'syrup', 'drops', 'inhalation', 'eye drops', 'cream', 'suppository', 'tab', 'powder', 'parenteral', 'ointment', 'nebule', 'syringe', 'supp', 'spray', 'sachet', 'gargle', 'eye drop', 'carpule'],
      categories: ['ANTI-HYPERTENSIVES', 'ANTI-THROMBOTICS', 'ANTI-ASTHMA & COPD', 'ANTI-DIABETICS', 'ANTI-DYSLIPIDEMIA', 'ANTI-BIOTICS / MICROBIALS', 'NERVOUS SYSTEM', 'SUPPORTIVE / OTHER THERAPHY', 'VITAMINS', 'ANTI-ALLERGY/HISTAMINE', 'EXPANDERS', 'DANGEROUS/REGULATED', 'ANALGESICS', 'ANTIDEPRESSANTS / PSYCHOTICS', 'ANTI-GOUT', 'ANTI-VERTIGO', 'CORTICOSTEROIDS', 'DIURETICS', 'ANESTHESIA / OR', 'IV FLUIDS', 'GASTROINTESTINAL', 'ELECTROLYTES', 'OPTHALMIC PREPARATIONS', 'VACCINES / BIOLOGICALS', 'ANTI-THYROID AGENTS', 'MUSCLE RELAXANT', 'SURFACTANT', 'SMALL VIALS', 'COUGH SUPPRESSANTS', 'ANTI-NEOPLASTICS / ONCO', 'CARDIOVASCULAR', 'BRONCHODILATORS', 'NEUROMUSCULAR BLOCKER', 'ANTI-CHOLINERGIC', 'IMMUNOSUPPRESSANTS', 'LAXATIVE', 'ANTIDOTE', 'ANTI-EPILEPTIC', 'Total Parenteral Nutrition'],
    }
    
    const storageKey = 'pharma-regular-dropdown-options'
    
    export function getRegularDropdownOptions() {
      try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(window.localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || 'null')
        return {
          units: Array.isArray(saved?.units) ? saved.units : [...defaultRegularDropdownOptions.units],
          categories: Array.isArray(saved?.categories) ? saved.categories : [...defaultRegularDropdownOptions.categories],
        }
      } catch {
        return { units: [...defaultRegularDropdownOptions.units], categories: [...defaultRegularDropdownOptions.categories] }
      }
    }
    
    export function saveRegularDropdownOptions(options) {
      try {
        window.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(options))
      } catch {
        // Keep the current screen usable if browser storage is unavailable.
      }
    }

    import './StockCardView.css'
    
    function displayDate(value) {
      if (!value) return ''
      const date = new Date(value)
      return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? value : `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}/${date.getFullYear()}`
    }
    
    export default function StockCardView({ item, stockMonth, onBack }) {
      const [year, month] = stockMonth.split('-').map(Number)
      const movements = [
        ...(item.deliveries || []).map((delivery) => ({ date: delivery.date, reference: delivery.vendor, receipt: Number(delivery.qty) || 0, issue: 0 })),
        ...Object.entries(item.daily || {}).filter(([day, qty]) => day !== 'return' && Number(qty) > 0).map(([day, qty]) => ({ date: `${month}/${day}/${year}`, reference: '', receipt: 0, issue: Number(qty) || 0 })),
      ].sort((left, right) => new Date(left.date).getTime() - new Date(right.date).getTime())
    
      let balance = Number(item.beginning) || 0
      const ledgerRows = movements.length ? movements.map((movement) => {
        balance += movement.receipt - movement.issue
        return { ...movement, balance }
      }) : [{ date: '', reference: 'Beginning balance', receipt: '', issue: '', balance, office: '', days: '' }]
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content stock-card-page">
          <section className="dashboard-card stock-card-sheet" aria-label="Stock card">
            <div className="stock-card-sheet-heading">
              <div className="stock-card-main-title">STOCK CARD</div>
              <div className="stock-card-stock-no"><span>Stock No.:</span><strong>{item.no}</strong></div>
              <div className="stock-card-item-name">Item {item.no} {item.name}</div>
              <div className="stock-card-description"><span>Description:</span><strong>{[item.unit, item.category].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')}</strong></div>
              <div className="stock-card-reorder"><span>Re-order Point</span><strong>—</strong></div>
            </div>
            <div className="stock-card-table-scroll">
              <table className="stock-card-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="stock-card-groups"><th rowSpan="2">Date</th><th rowSpan="2">Reference</th><th colSpan="1">Receipt</th><th colSpan="2">Issuance</th><th colSpan="1">Balance</th><th rowSpan="2">No. of Days to Consume</th></tr>
                  <tr><th>Qty.</th><th>Qty.</th><th>Office</th><th>Qty.</th></tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {ledgerRows.map((row, index) => <tr key={`${row.date}-${index}`}><td>{displayDate(row.date)}</td><td>{row.reference || ''}</td><td>{row.receipt}</td><td>{row.issue}</td><td>{row.office || ''}</td><td>{row.balance}</td><td>{row.days || ''}</td></tr>)}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <footer className="stock-card-sheet-footer"><span>{item.name}</span><span>{new Date(year, month - 1, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}</span></footer>
          </section>
          <button className="stock-card-back-button" type="button" onClick={onBack}>← Back to Regular inventory</button>
        </div>
      )
    }

    import { useEffect } from 'react'
    import './StockCardView.css'
    
    function displayDate(value) {
      if (!value) return ''
      const date = new Date(value)
      return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? value : `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}/${date.getFullYear()}`
    }
    
    export default function StockCardView({ item, stockMonth, onBack }) {
      useEffect(() => {
        const printTimer = window.setTimeout(() => window.print(), 400)
        return () => window.clearTimeout(printTimer)
      }, [])
    
      const [year, month] = stockMonth.split('-').map(Number)
      const movements = [
        ...(item.deliveries || []).map((delivery) => ({ date: delivery.date, reference: delivery.vendor, receipt: Number(delivery.qty) || 0, issue: 0 })),
        ...Object.entries(item.daily || {}).filter(([day, qty]) => day !== 'return' && Number(qty) > 0).map(([day, qty]) => ({ date: `${month}/${day}/${year}`, reference: '', receipt: 0, issue: Number(qty) || 0 })),
      ].sort((left, right) => new Date(left.date).getTime() - new Date(right.date).getTime())
    
      let balance = Number(item.beginning) || 0
      const ledgerRows = movements.length ? movements.map((movement) => {
        balance += movement.receipt - movement.issue
        return { ...movement, balance }
      }) : [{ date: '', reference: 'Beginning balance', receipt: '', issue: '', balance, office: '', days: '' }]
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content stock-card-page">
          <section className="dashboard-card stock-card-sheet" aria-label="Stock card">
            <div className="stock-card-sheet-heading">
              <div className="stock-card-main-title">STOCK CARD</div>
              <div className="stock-card-stock-no"><span>Stock No.:</span><strong>{item.no}</strong></div>
              <div className="stock-card-item-name">Item {item.no} {item.name}</div>
              <div className="stock-card-description"><span>Description:</span><strong>{[item.unit, item.category].filter(Boolean).join(' Â· ')}</strong></div>
              <div className="stock-card-reorder"><span>Re-order Point</span><strong>â€”</strong></div>
            </div>
            <div className="stock-card-table-scroll">
              <table className="stock-card-table">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="stock-card-groups"><th rowSpan="2">Date</th><th rowSpan="2">Reference</th><th colSpan="1">Receipt</th><th colSpan="2">Issuance</th><th colSpan="1">Balance</th><th rowSpan="2">No. of Days to Consume</th></tr>
                  <tr><th>Qty.</th><th>Qty.</th><th>Office</th><th>Qty.</th></tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {ledgerRows.map((row, index) => <tr key={`${row.date}-${index}`}><td>{displayDate(row.date)}</td><td>{row.reference || ''}</td><td>{row.receipt}</td><td>{row.issue}</td><td>{row.office || ''}</td><td>{row.balance}</td><td>{row.days || ''}</td></tr>)}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <footer className="stock-card-sheet-footer"><span>{item.name}</span><span>{new Date(year, month - 1, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}</span></footer>
          </section>
          <button className="stock-card-back-button" type="button" onClick={onBack}>â† Back to Regular inventory</button>
        </div>
      )
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[character])
    }
    
    function formatDate(value) {
      if (!value) return ''
      const date = new Date(value)
      return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? value : `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}/${date.getFullYear()}`
    }
    
    export function createStockCardPrintDocument(item, stockMonth) {
      const [year, month] = stockMonth.split('-').map(Number)
      const movements = [
        ...(item.deliveries || []).map((delivery) => ({ date: delivery.date, reference: delivery.vendor, receipt: Number(delivery.qty) || 0, issue: 0, office: '', days: '' })),
        ...Object.entries(item.daily || {}).filter(([day, quantity]) => day !== 'return' && Number(quantity) > 0).map(([day, quantity]) => ({ date: `${month}/${day}/${year}`, reference: '', receipt: 0, issue: Number(quantity) || 0, office: '', days: '' })),
      ].sort((left, right) => new Date(left.date).getTime() - new Date(right.date).getTime())
    
      let balance = Number(item.beginning) || 0
      const entries = movements.length
        ? movements.map((movement) => {
          balance += movement.receipt - movement.issue
          return { ...movement, balance }
        })
        : [{ date: '', reference: 'Beginning balance', receipt: '', issue: '', office: '', balance, days: '' }]
      while (entries.length < 20) entries.push({ date: '', reference: '', receipt: '', issue: '', office: '', balance: '', days: '' })
    
      const bodyRows = entries.map((row) => `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(formatDate(row.date))}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.reference)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.receipt)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.issue)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.office)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.balance)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(row.days)}</td></tr>`).join('')
      const title = `Stock Card - ${item.name || 'Regular inventory'}`
      const description = [item.unit, item.category].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')
      const monthLabel = new Date(year, month - 1, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })
    
      return `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>${escapeHtml(title)}</title><style>
        @page{size:landscape;margin:10mm}*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#fff;color:#111;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}.sheet{width:100%;border:1px solid #111}.head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:72% 28%;grid-template-rows:26px 42px 30px;border-bottom:1px solid #111;font-size:12px}.title{padding:6px 9px;font-weight:700}.stock-no{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3;border-left:1px solid #111;padding:6px 9px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}.stock-no strong{font-weight:400}.item{align-self:end;padding:6px 9px}.description,.reorder{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-top:1px solid #111;padding:0 9px}.reorder{grid-column:2;grid-row:3;border-left:1px solid #111}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;table-layout:fixed;font-size:11px;text-align:center}col.date{width:13%}col.reference{width:16%}col.receipt,col.issue,col.office,col.balance{width:13%}col.days{width:19%}th,td{height:20pt;padding:4pt 5pt;border:1px solid #111;vertical-align:middle;font-weight:400}thead th{height:23pt;background:#fff}.balance-cell{font-weight:700}.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 9px;color:#505750;font-size:9px}@media screen{body{padding:18px;background:#f0f2f0}.sheet{max-width:1100px;margin:auto;box-shadow:0 3px 18px #0002}.toolbar{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto 10px;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end}.toolbar button{padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid #176345;border-radius:6px;background:#176345;color:white;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}}@media print{.toolbar{display:none}}

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[character])
    }
    
    function formatDate(value) {
      if (!value) return ''
      const date = new Date(value)
      return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? value : `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}/${date.getFullYear()}`
    }
    
    export function createStockCardPrintDocument(item, stockMonth) {
      const [year, month] = stockMonth.split('-').map(Number)
      const movements = [
        ...(item.deliveries || []).map((delivery) => ({ date: delivery.date, reference: delivery.vendor, receipt: Number(delivery.qty) || 0, issue: 0, office: '', days: '' })),
        ...Object.entries(item.daily || {}).filter(([day, quantity]) => day !== 'return' && Number(quantity) > 0).map(([day, quantity]) => ({ date: `${month}/${day}/${year}`, reference: '', receipt: 0, issue: Number(quantity) || 0, office: '', days: '' })),
      ].sort((left, right) => new Date(left.date).getTime() - new Date(right.date).getTime())
    
      let balance = Number(item.beginning) || 0

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[character])
    }
    
    function formatDate(value) {
      if (!value) return ''
      const date = new Date(value)
      return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? value : `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}/${date.getFullYear()}`
    }
    
    export function createStockCardPrintDocument(item, stockMonth) {
      const [year, month] = stockMonth.split('-').map(Number)
      const movements = [
        ...(item.deliveries || []).map((delivery) => ({ date: delivery.date, reference: delivery.vendor, receipt: Number(delivery.qty) || 0, issue: 0, office: '', days: '' })),
        ...Object.entries(item.daily || {}).filter(([day, quantity]) => day !== 'return' && Number(quantity) > 0).map(([day, quantity]) => ({ date: `${month}/${day}/${year}`, reference: '', receipt: 0, issue: Number(quantity) || 0, office: '', days: '' })),
      ].sort((left, right) => new Date(left.date).getTime() - new Date(right.date).getTime())
    
      const beginningBalance = Number(item.beginning) || 0

      const bodyRows = editableRows

    <?php
    declare(strict_types=1);
    
    header('X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff');
    header('Cache-Control: no-store');
    
    function api_json(int $status, array $payload): never
    {
        http_response_code($status);
        header('Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8');
        echo json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        exit;
    }
    
    function api_require_method(string $method): void
    {
        if (strtoupper($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '') !== strtoupper($method)) {
            header('Allow: ' . strtoupper($method));
            api_json(405, ['error' => 'Method not allowed.']);
        }
    }
    
    function api_start_session(): void
    {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_ACTIVE) {
            return;
        }
    
        $sessionPath = sys_get_temp_dir() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'jvgh-pharma-sessions';
        if (!is_dir($sessionPath) && !mkdir($sessionPath, 0700, true) && !is_dir($sessionPath)) {
            error_log('Pharmacy API could not create its PHP session directory.');
            api_json(500, ['error' => 'Could not initialize a secure login session.']);
        }
    
        ini_set('session.use_strict_mode', '1');
        session_name('pharma_session');
        session_save_path($sessionPath);
        session_set_cookie_params([
            'lifetime' => 0,
            'path' => '/',
            'secure' => !empty($_SERVER['HTTPS']) && $_SERVER['HTTPS'] !== 'off',
            'httponly' => true,
            'samesite' => 'Strict',
        ]);
        session_start();
    }
    
    function api_require_csrf(): void
    {
        $provided = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_CSRF_TOKEN'] ?? '';
        $expected = $_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '';
    
        if (!is_string($provided) || !is_string($expected) || $expected === '' || !hash_equals($expected, $provided)) {
            api_json(403, ['error' => 'Your session expired. Refresh the page and try again.']);
        }
    }
    
    function api_json_body(): array
    {
        $body = file_get_contents('php://input');
    
        try {
            $data = json_decode($body === false ? '' : $body, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (JsonException) {
            api_json(400, ['error' => 'Invalid JSON request.']);
        }
    
        if (!is_array($data)) {
            api_json(400, ['error' => 'Invalid request body.']);
        }
    
        return $data;
    }
    
    function api_db(): PDO
    {
        static $connection = null;
        if ($connection instanceof PDO) {
            return $connection;
        }
    
        $configPath = __DIR__ . '/config.local.php';
        if (!is_file($configPath)) {
            api_json(503, ['error' => 'Database is not configured. Copy API/config.example.php to API/config.local.php and set the MySQL credentials.']);
        }
    
        $config = require $configPath;
        if (!is_array($config)) {
            error_log('Pharmacy API configuration must return an array.');
            api_json(500, ['error' => 'Database configuration is invalid.']);
        }
    
        foreach (['host', 'port', 'database', 'username', 'password'] as $key) {
            if (!array_key_exists($key, $config)) {
                error_log('Pharmacy API configuration is missing ' . $key . '.');
                api_json(500, ['error' => 'Database configuration is invalid.']);
            }
        }
    
        $dsn = sprintf(
            'mysql:host=%s;port=%d;dbname=%s;charset=utf8mb4',
            $config['host'],
            (int) $config['port'],
            $config['database']
        );
    
        try {
            $connection = new PDO($dsn, $config['username'], $config['password'], [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
                PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES => false,
            ]);
        } catch (PDOException $error) {
            error_log('Pharmacy API database connection failed: ' . $error->getMessage());
            api_json(503, ['error' => 'Cannot connect to MySQL. Check the API configuration and make sure XAMPP MySQL is running.']);
        }
    
        return $connection;
    }
    
    function api_current_user(PDO $connection): ?array
    {
        $userId = $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null;
        if (!is_int($userId) || $userId < 1) {
            return null;
        }
    
        try {
            $statement = $connection->prepare(
                'SELECT u.user_id, u.full_name, u.username, u.is_active, r.role_name
                 FROM users u
                 LEFT JOIN user_roles ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id
                 LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id
                 WHERE u.user_id = :user_id
                 ORDER BY r.role_name'
            );
            $statement->execute(['user_id' => $userId]);
            $rows = $statement->fetchAll();
        } catch (PDOException $error) {
            error_log('Pharmacy API session lookup failed: ' . $error->getMessage());
            api_json(500, ['error' => 'Could not verify the current user session.']);
        }
    
        if ($rows === [] || (int) $rows[0]['is_active'] !== 1) {
            unset($_SESSION['user_id']);
            session_regenerate_id(true);
            $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
            return null;
        }
    
        $roles = array_values(array_unique(array_filter(array_column($rows, 'role_name'))));
        if ($roles === []) {
            unset($_SESSION['user_id']);
            session_regenerate_id(true);
            $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
            return null;
        }
    
        return [
            'id' => (int) $rows[0]['user_id'],
            'fullName' => $rows[0]['full_name'],
            'username' => $rows[0]['username'],
            'roles' => $roles,
        ];
    }
    
    function api_require_roles(array $allowedRoles): array
    {
        api_start_session();
        $user = api_current_user(api_db());
        if ($user === null) {
            api_json(401, ['error' => 'Authentication required.']);
        }
    
        if (array_intersect($allowedRoles, $user['roles']) === []) {
            api_json(403, ['error' => 'You do not have permission to perform this action.']);
        }
    
        return $user;
    }

    export default function MhmapInventory({ stockMonth, onStockMonthChange, monthLabel }) {
      const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
      const visibleRows = sampleMhmapRows.filter((item) =>
        item.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()),
      )
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content mhmap-inventory-page">
          <section className="dashboard-card regular-ledger-card" id="mhmap">
            <div className="ledger-heading">
              <div><span className="ledger-kicker">E-STOCK / MHMAP</span><h2>MHMAP inventory</h2><p>Monthly stock card Â· {monthLabel}</p></div>
              <div className="ledger-actions"><span className="sample-indicator"><i /> Sample data</span><MonthYearPicker value={stockMonth} onChange={onStockMonthChange} /></div>
            </div>
            <div className="regular-tools mhmap-search-tools" role="search" aria-label="Search MHMAP inventory items">
              <label className="regular-search"><span className="sr-only">Search Items</span><SearchIcon /><input type="search" placeholder="Search Items" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} /></label>
            </div>
            <div className="ledger-hint"><span>â†”</span> Swipe or scroll horizontally to view all stock-card columns</div>
            {visibleRows.length === 0 && <p className="regular-empty-results">No items match your search.</p>}
            <MonthlyStockCard rows={visibleRows} periodLabels={mhmapWeeklyRanges} monthLabel={monthLabel} />
          </section>
        </div>
      )
    }
    
    function SearchIcon() {
      return <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8.7" cy="8.7" r="5.7" /><path d="m13 13 4 4" /></svg>
    }

    export default function ExportEstockButton() {
      async function downloadWorkbook() {
        try {
          const response = await fetch('/templates/E-STOCK.xlsx')
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Workbook template could not be loaded.')
    
          const workbook = await response.blob()
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(workbook)
          const link = document.createElement('a')
          link.href = url
          link.download = 'E-STOCK.xlsx'
          document.body.appendChild(link)
          link.click()
          link.remove()
          window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000)
        } catch {
          window.alert('Hindi ma-download ang E-STOCK.xlsx. Pakisubukan ulit.')
        }
      }
    
      return (
        <button className="regular-export-button" type="button" onClick={downloadWorkbook}>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3v9m0 0 3.5-3.5M10 12 6.5 8.5M4 13v3h12v-3" /></svg>
          Export Excel
        </button>
      )
    }

    const XLSX_MIME = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
    const encoder = new TextEncoder()
    
    function crc32(bytes) {
      let crc = 0xffffffff
      for (const byte of bytes) {
        crc ^= byte
        for (let bit = 0; bit < 8; bit += 1) crc = (crc >>> 1) ^ (crc & 1 ? 0xedb88320 : 0)
      }
      return (crc ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0
    }
    
    function findEndOfCentralDirectory(bytes) {
      const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength)
      for (let offset = bytes.length - 22; offset >= Math.max(0, bytes.length - 65557); offset -= 1) {
        if (view.getUint32(offset, true) === 0x06054b50) return offset
      }
      throw new Error('Invalid Excel workbook archive.')
    }
    
    function readZipEntries(buffer) {
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer)
      const view = new DataView(buffer)
      const endOffset = findEndOfCentralDirectory(bytes)
      const totalEntries = view.getUint16(endOffset + 10, true)
      const centralOffset = view.getUint32(endOffset + 16, true)
      const decoder = new TextDecoder()
      const entries = []
      let cursor = centralOffset
    
      for (let index = 0; index < totalEntries; index += 1) {
        if (view.getUint32(cursor, true) !== 0x02014b50) throw new Error('Invalid Excel workbook directory.')
        const flags = view.getUint16(cursor + 8, true)
        const method = view.getUint16(cursor + 10, true)
        const crc = view.getUint32(cursor + 16, true)
        const compressedSize = view.getUint32(cursor + 20, true)
        const uncompressedSize = view.getUint32(cursor + 24, true)
        const nameLength = view.getUint16(cursor + 28, true)
        const extraLength = view.getUint16(cursor + 30, true)
        const commentLength = view.getUint16(cursor + 32, true)
        const localOffset = view.getUint32(cursor + 42, true)
        const name = decoder.decode(bytes.subarray(cursor + 46, cursor + 46 + nameLength))
        const localNameLength = view.getUint16(localOffset + 26, true)
        const localExtraLength = view.getUint16(localOffset + 28, true)
        const dataOffset = localOffset + 30 + localNameLength + localExtraLength
    
        entries.push({
          name,
          flags,
          method,
          crc,
          compressedSize,
          uncompressedSize,
          compressedData: bytes.slice(dataOffset, dataOffset + compressedSize),
        })
        cursor += 46 + nameLength + extraLength + commentLength
      }
      return entries
    }
    
    async function transformBytes(bytes, format, Constructor) {
      if (typeof Constructor !== 'function') throw new Error('This browser does not support Excel workbook editing.')
      const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new Constructor(format))
      return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer())
    }
    
    function xmlEscape(value) {
      return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&apos;' })[character])
    }
    
    function cellXml(reference, value, style) {
      const styleAttribute = style ? ` s="${style}"` : ''
      if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return `<c r="${reference}"${styleAttribute}><v>${value}</v></c>`
      return `<c r="${reference}"${styleAttribute} t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${xmlEscape(value)}</t></is></c>`
    }
    
    function setCell(xml, reference, value) {
      const escapedReference = reference.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
      const cellPattern = new RegExp(`<c\\b(?=[^>]*\\br="${escapedReference}")[^>]*(?:\\/>|>[\\s\\S]*?<\\/c>)`)
      const existing = xml.match(cellPattern)
      if (existing) {
        const style = existing[0].match(/\bs="(\d+)"/)?.[1]
        return xml.replace(cellPattern, cellXml(reference, value, style))
      }
      const rowNumber = Number(reference.match(/\d+$/)?.[0])
      const rowPattern = new RegExp(`<row\\b(?=[^>]*\\br="${rowNumber}")[^>]*>[\\s\\S]*?<\\/row>`)
      const row = xml.match(rowPattern)
      if (!row) return xml
      const cell = cellXml(reference, value)
      return xml.replace(rowPattern, row[0].replace('</row>', `${cell}</row>`))
    }
    
    function excelColumn(index) {
      let label = ''
      for (let value = index; value > 0; value = Math.floor((value - 1) / 26)) label = String.fromCharCode(65 + ((value - 1) % 26)) + label
      return label
    }
    
    function regularCellValues(item, rowNumber) {
      const values = {
        A: item.no,
        B: item.name,
        C: item.unit,
        D: Number(String(item.price ?? '').replace(/[^\d.-]/g, '')) || '',
        E: Number(String(item.dpri ?? '').replace(/[^\d.-]/g, '')) || '',
        F: item.category,
        G: item.other,
        H: item.expiry,
        I: item.lot,
        J: item.beginning,
        K: (item.deliveries || []).map((delivery) => delivery.date || '').filter(Boolean).join('\n'),
        L: (item.deliveries || []).map((delivery) => delivery.qty ?? '').filter((qty) => qty !== '').join('\n'),
        AS: item.ending,
        AT: item.monthly,
      }
      for (let day = 1; day <= 31; day += 1) {
        const columnIndex = day <= 3 ? day + 12 : day + 13
        values[excelColumn(columnIndex)] = item.daily?.[day] ?? ''
      }
      ;(item.weekly || []).slice(0, 5).forEach((qty, index) => {
        values[excelColumn(47 + index)] = qty
      })
      return Object.entries(values).map(([column, value]) => [`${column}${rowNumber}`, value])
    }

      view.setUint32(0, 0x06054b50, true)
      view.setUint16(8, files.length, true)
      view.setUint16(10, files.length, true)
      view.setUint32(12, offset - centralOffset, true)
      view.setUint32(16, centralOffset, true)
      push(end)
      return new Blob(chunks, { type: XLSX_MIME })
    }
    
    export async function createEstockWorkbook(rows = []) {
      const response = await fetch('/templates/E-STOCK.xlsx')
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Hindi ma-load ang E-STOCK.xlsx template.')
    
      const entries = readZipEntries(await response.arrayBuffer())
      const regularSheet = entries.find((entry) => entry.name === 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml')
      if (!regularSheet) throw new Error('Walang REGULAR sheet sa E-STOCK.xlsx template.')
    
      const regularXml = await transformBytes(regularSheet.compressedData, 'deflate-raw', DecompressionStream)
      let xml = new TextDecoder().decode(regularXml)
      rows.forEach((item, index) => {
        regularCellValues(item, index + 3).forEach(([reference, value]) => {
          if (value !== '' && value !== null && value !== undefined) xml = setCell(xml, reference, value)
        })
      })
      regularSheet.updatedText = xml
      return writeZip(entries)
    }

    import { createEstockWorkbook } from '../utils/xlsxTemplateExport.js'
    
    export default function ExportEstockButton({ rows = [] }) {
      async function downloadWorkbook() {
        try {
          const workbook = await createEstockWorkbook(rows)
          const url = URL.createObjectURL(workbook)
          const link = document.createElement('a')
          link.href = url
          link.download = 'E-STOCK.xlsx'
          document.body.appendChild(link)
          link.click()
          link.remove()
          window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000)
        } catch {
          window.alert(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Hindi ma-download ang E-STOCK.xlsx. Pakisubukan ulit.')
        }
      }
    
      return (
        <button className="regular-export-button" type="button" onClick={downloadWorkbook}>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 3v9m0 0 3.5-3.5M10 12 6.5 8.5M4 13v3h12v-3" /></svg>
          Export Excel
        </button>
      )
    }
    const XLSX_MIME = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
    const encoder = new TextEncoder()
    
    function crc32(bytes) {
      let crc = 0xffffffff
      for (const byte of bytes) {
        crc ^= byte
        for (let bit = 0; bit < 8; bit += 1) crc = (crc >>> 1) ^ (crc & 1 ? 0xedb88320 : 0)
      }
      return (crc ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0
    }
    
    function findEndOfCentralDirectory(bytes) {
      const view = new DataView(bytes.buffer, bytes.byteOffset, bytes.byteLength)
      for (let offset = bytes.length - 22; offset >= Math.max(0, bytes.length - 65557); offset -= 1) {
        if (view.getUint32(offset, true) === 0x06054b50) return offset
      }
      throw new Error('Invalid Excel workbook archive.')
    }
    
    function readZipEntries(buffer) {
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(buffer)
      const view = new DataView(buffer)
      const endOffset = findEndOfCentralDirectory(bytes)
      const totalEntries = view.getUint16(endOffset + 10, true)
      const centralOffset = view.getUint32(endOffset + 16, true)
      const decoder = new TextDecoder()
      const entries = []
      let cursor = centralOffset
    
      for (let index = 0; index < totalEntries; index += 1) {
        if (view.getUint32(cursor, true) !== 0x02014b50) throw new Error('Invalid Excel workbook directory.')
        const flags = view.getUint16(cursor + 8, true)
        const method = view.getUint16(cursor + 10, true)
        const crc = view.getUint32(cursor + 16, true)
        const compressedSize = view.getUint32(cursor + 20, true)
        const uncompressedSize = view.getUint32(cursor + 24, true)
        const nameLength = view.getUint16(cursor + 28, true)
        const extraLength = view.getUint16(cursor + 30, true)
        const commentLength = view.getUint16(cursor + 32, true)
        const localOffset = view.getUint32(cursor + 42, true)
        const name = decoder.decode(bytes.subarray(cursor + 46, cursor + 46 + nameLength))
        const localNameLength = view.getUint16(localOffset + 26, true)
        const localExtraLength = view.getUint16(localOffset + 28, true)
        const dataOffset = localOffset + 30 + localNameLength + localExtraLength
    
        entries.push({
          name,
          flags,
          method,
          crc,
          compressedSize,
          uncompressedSize,
          compressedData: bytes.slice(dataOffset, dataOffset + compressedSize),
        })
        cursor += 46 + nameLength + extraLength + commentLength
      }
      return entries
    }
    
    async function transformBytes(bytes, format, Constructor) {
      if (typeof Constructor !== 'function') throw new Error('This browser does not support Excel workbook editing.')
      const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new Constructor(format))
      return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer())
    }
    
    function xmlEscape(value) {
      return String(value ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&apos;' })[character])
    }
    
    function cellXml(reference, value, style) {
      const styleAttribute = style ? ` s="${style}"` : ''
      if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value)) return `<c r="${reference}"${styleAttribute}><v>${value}</v></c>`
      return `<c r="${reference}"${styleAttribute} t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${xmlEscape(value)}</t></is></c>`
    }
    
    function setCell(xml, reference, value) {
      const escapedReference = reference.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')
      const cellPattern = new RegExp(`<c\\b(?=[^>]*\\br="${escapedReference}")[^>]*?(?:\\/>|>[\\s\\S]*?<\\/c>)`)
      const existing = xml.match(cellPattern)
      if (existing) {
        const style = existing[0].match(/\bs="(\d+)"/)?.[1]
        return xml.replace(cellPattern, cellXml(reference, value, style))
      }
      const rowNumber = Number(reference.match(/\d+$/)?.[0])
      const rowPattern = new RegExp(`<row\\b(?=[^>]*\\br="${rowNumber}")[^>]*>[\\s\\S]*?<\\/row>`)
      const row = xml.match(rowPattern)
      if (!row) return xml
      const cell = cellXml(reference, value)
      return xml.replace(rowPattern, row[0].replace('</row>', `${cell}</row>`))
    }
    
    function excelColumn(index) {
      let label = ''
      for (let value = index; value > 0; value = Math.floor((value - 1) / 26)) label = String.fromCharCode(65 + ((value - 1) % 26)) + label
      return label
    }
    
    function regularCellValues(item, rowNumber) {
      const values = {
        A: item.no,
        B: item.name,
        C: item.unit,
        D: Number(String(item.price ?? '').replace(/[^\d.-]/g, '')) || '',
        E: Number(String(item.dpri ?? '').replace(/[^\d.-]/g, '')) || '',
        F: item.category,
        G: item.other,
        H: item.expiry,
        I: item.lot,
        J: item.beginning,
        K: (item.deliveries || []).map((delivery) => delivery.date || '').filter(Boolean).join('\n'),
        L: (item.deliveries || []).map((delivery) => delivery.qty ?? '').filter((qty) => qty !== '').join('\n'),
        AS: item.ending,
        AT: item.monthly,
      }
      for (let day = 1; day <= 31; day += 1) {
        const columnIndex = day <= 3 ? day + 12 : day + 13
        values[excelColumn(columnIndex)] = item.daily?.[day] ?? ''
      }
      ;(item.weekly || []).slice(0, 5).forEach((qty, index) => {
        values[excelColumn(47 + index)] = qty
      })
      return Object.entries(values).map(([column, value]) => [`${column}${rowNumber}`, value])
    }
    
    async function writeZip(entries) {
      const files = []
      for (const entry of entries) {
        const nameBytes = encoder.encode(entry.name)
        const compressedData = entry.updatedText === undefined
          ? entry.compressedData
          : await transformBytes(encoder.encode(entry.updatedText), 'deflate-raw', CompressionStream)
        const uncompressedData = entry.updatedText === undefined ? null : encoder.encode(entry.updatedText)
        files.push({
          nameBytes,
          compressedData,
          crc: uncompressedData ? crc32(uncompressedData) : entry.crc,
          uncompressedSize: uncompressedData?.length ?? entry.uncompressedSize,
          method: entry.updatedText === undefined ? entry.method : 8,
        })

    import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
    import AdminDashboard from "./pages/AdminDashboard.jsx";
    import { requestJson, roleTitle } from "./services/api.js";
    import "./App.css";
    export default function App() {
      const [auth, setAuth] = useState({
        status: "loading",
        user: null,
        csrfToken: "",
      });
      const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
      const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
      const [error, setError] = useState("");
      const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
    
      async function loadSession() {
        setError("");
        setAuth((current) => ({ ...current, status: "loading" }));
    
        try {
          const session = await requestJson("/api/auth/session.php");
          setAuth({
            status: "ready",
            user: session.user,
            csrfToken: session.csrfToken,
          });
        } catch (requestError) {
          setAuth({ status: "error", user: null, csrfToken: "" });
          setError(requestError.message || "Could not connect to the PHP API.");
        }
      }
    
      useEffect(() => {
        let active = true;
    
        requestJson("/api/auth/session.php")
          .then((session) => {
            if (active) {
              setAuth({
                status: "ready",
                user: session.user,
                csrfToken: session.csrfToken,
              });
            }
          })
          .catch((requestError) => {
            if (active) {
              setAuth({ status: "error", user: null, csrfToken: "" });
              setError(requestError.message || "Could not connect to the PHP API.");
            }
          });
    
        return () => {
          active = false;
        };
      }, []);
    
      async function handleLogin(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        setError("");
        setSubmitting(true);
    
        try {
          const result = await requestJson("/api/auth/login.php", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type": "application/json",
              "X-CSRF-Token": auth.csrfToken,
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
          });
          setAuth({
            status: "ready",
            user: result.user,
            csrfToken: result.csrfToken,
          });
          setPassword("");
        } catch (requestError) {
          setError(requestError.message || "Login failed. Please try again.");
        } finally {
          setSubmitting(false);
        }
      }
    
      async function handleLogout() {
        setError("");
        setSubmitting(true);
    
        try {
          const result = await requestJson("/api/auth/logout.php", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "X-CSRF-Token": auth.csrfToken },
          });
          try {
            window.sessionStorage.removeItem("pharma-dashboard-section");
          } catch {
            // Ignore storage cleanup failures during sign out.
          }
          setAuth({ status: "ready", user: null, csrfToken: result.csrfToken });
          setPassword("");
        } catch (requestError) {
          setError(requestError.message || "Could not sign out. Please try again.");
        } finally {
          setSubmitting(false);
        }
      }
    
      if (auth.status === "loading") {
        return (
          <main className="page-shell">
            <div className="loading-card" role="status">
              Connecting to JVGH Pharmacyâ€¦
            </div>
          </main>
        );
      }
    
      if (auth.user) {
        const roles = auth.user.roles || [];
        const isAdmin = roles.includes("admin");
    
        if (isAdmin) {
          return (
            <AdminDashboard
              user={auth.user}
              csrfToken={auth.csrfToken}
              onLogout={handleLogout}
              submitting={submitting}
            />
          );
        }
    
        return (
          <main className="page-shell">
            <header className="topbar">
              <a className="brand" href="/" aria-label="JVGH Pharmacy home">
                <span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">
                  +
                </span>
                <span>
                  JVGH <strong>PHARMACY</strong>
                </span>
              </a>
              <button
                className="text-button"
                type="button"
                onClick={handleLogout}
                disabled={submitting}
              >
                {submitting ? "Signing outâ€¦" : "Sign out"}
              </button>
            </header>
    
            <section className="welcome-panel">
              <div className="welcome-copy">
                <p className="eyebrow">PHARMACY INVENTORY SYSTEM</p>
                <h1>Welcome, {auth.user.fullName}</h1>
                <p className="welcome-description">
                  You are signed in. Your account role determines which pharmacy
                  tools you can use.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="role-card">
                <span className="role-card-label">SIGNED IN AS</span>
                <div className="role-list">
                  {roles.map((role) => (
                    <span className="role-badge" key={role}>
                      {roleTitle(role)}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <p>{auth.user.username}</p>
              </div>
            </section>
    
            <section className="next-step-card">
              <div className="next-step-icon" aria-hidden="true">
                âœ“
              </div>
              <div>
                <h2>{isAdmin ? "Administrator access" : "Pharmacist access"}</h2>
                <p>
                  {isAdmin
                    ? "Admin accounts are intended to manage users and the pharmacy system."
                    : "Pharmacist accounts are intended to work with inventory and stock cards, without user management."}
                </p>
                <p className="module-note">
                  Login and role recognition are ready. Inventory and
                  user-management screens are next.
                </p>
              </div>
            </section>
    
            {error && (
              <p className="form-message form-message-error" role="alert">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}
          </main>
        );
      }
    
      return (
        <main className="page-shell login-layout">
          <section className="login-intro" aria-label="Pharmacy inventory system">
            <a className="brand" href="/" aria-label="JVGH Pharmacy home">
              <span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">
                +
              </span>
              <span>
                JVGH <strong>PHARMACY</strong>
              </span>
            </a>
            <div className="intro-copy">
              <p className="eyebrow">PHARMACY INVENTORY SYSTEM</p>
              <h1>Better visibility for every stock movement.</h1>
              <p>Sign in to continue to the pharmacy inventory workspace.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="intro-footer">
              Secure access for authorized pharmacy staff
            </div>
          </section>
    
          <section className="login-panel">
            <div className="login-heading">
              <p className="eyebrow">WELCOME BACK</p>
              <h2>Sign in to your account</h2>
              <p>Use the username and password assigned to you.</p>
            </div>
    
            {error && (
              <p className="form-message form-message-error" role="alert">
                {error}
              </p>
            )}
    
            {auth.status === "error" && (
              <button
                className="text-button retry-button"
                type="button"
                onClick={loadSession}
              >
                Retry connection
              </button>
            )}
    
            <form className="login-form" onSubmit={handleLogin}>
              <label htmlFor="username">Username</label>
              <input
                id="username"
                name="username"
                type="text"
                autoComplete="username"
                autoCapitalize="none"
                required
                value={username}
                onChange={(event) => setUsername(event.target.value)}
              />
    
              <label htmlFor="password">Password</label>
              <input
                id="password"
                name="password"
                type="password"
                autoComplete="current-password"
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
              />
    
              <button
                className="submit-button"
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting || !auth.csrfToken}
              >
                {submitting ? "Signing inâ€¦" : "Sign in"}
              </button>
            </form>
    
            <p className="login-note">
              Access is managed by your pharmacy system administrator.
            </p>
          </section>
        </main>
      );
    }

      { no: 9, name: 'Acetylcysteine 600mg tablet', unit: 'tablet', price: 'â‚±23.00', dpri: 'â‚±36.36', category: 'COUGH SUPPRESSANTS', other: '', expiry: '03/2029', lot: '2603085\n0495', beginning: 1661, deliveries: [{ date: '10/14/2026', qty: 50, vendor: 'OAK' }, { date: '10/23/2026', qty: 100, vendor: 'ICS' }], daily: { 1: 63, 2: 38, 3: 34, 5: 36 }, ending: 1490, monthly: 171, weekly: [135, 36, 0, 0, 0] },
      { no: 14, name: 'Albendazole 400mg tablet', unit: 'tablet', price: 'â‚±7.00', dpri: 'â‚±8.00', category: 'ANTI-BIOTICS / MICROBIALS', other: '', expiry: '02/2028\n10/2027', lot: 'XT6C022\nXT5K007', beginning: 294, deliveries: [{ date: '4/28/2026', qty: 200, vendor: 'DYNA' }, { date: '5/5/2026', qty: 100, vendor: 'OAK' }], daily: {}, ending: 294, monthly: 0, weekly: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0] },
    ]
    
    
    const weeklyRanges = ['1-7', '8-14', '15-21', '22-28', '29-30']
    const otherCategoryOptions = ['MOBCHA', 'YAKAP', 'OR', 'HIGH ALERT', 'NONE']
    const blankDelivery = () => ({ date: '', qty: '', vendor: '' })
    const blankItemForm = () => ({ name: '', unit: '', price: '', dpri: '', category: '', other: '', expiryDates: [''], lot: '', beginning: '', deliveries: [blankDelivery()], daily: {}, ending: '', monthly: '', weekly: ['', '', '', '', ''] })
    
    function toDateInput(value = '') {
      const match = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      return match ? `${match[3]}-${match[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${match[2].padStart(2, '0')}` : value
    }
    
    function toStockCardDate(value = '') {
      const match = value.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/)
      return match ? `${Number(match[2])}/${Number(match[3])}/${match[1]}` : value
    }
    
    function toExpiryDateInput(value = '') {
      const fullDate = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      if (fullDate) return `${fullDate[3]}-${fullDate[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${fullDate[2].padStart(2, '0')}`
      const monthYear = value.match(/^(\d{1,2})\/(\d{4})$/)
      if (monthYear) return `${monthYear[2]}-${monthYear[1].padStart(2, '0')}-01`
      return value.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/) ? value : ''
    }
    
    function toExpiryStockValue(value = '') {
      const match = value.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/)
      if (!match) return value
      return match[3] === '01'
        ? `${match[2]}/${match[1]}`
        : `${Number(match[2])}/${Number(match[3])}/${match[1]}`
    }
    
    export default function RegularInventory({ stockMonth, onStockMonthChange, onOpenStockCard }) {
      const [rows, setRows] = useState(sampleRegularRows)
      const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
      const [unitFilter, setUnitFilter] = useState('all')
      const [categoryFilter, setCategoryFilter] = useState('all')
      const [sort, setSort] = useState('default')
      const [addItemOpen, setAddItemOpen] = useState(false)
      const [editingItemNo, setEditingItemNo] = useState(null)
      const [itemForm, setItemForm] = useState(blankItemForm)
      const [dropdownOptions] = useState(getRegularDropdownOptions)
      const [year, monthNumber] = stockMonth.split('-').map(Number)
      const monthLabel = new Date(year, monthNumber - 1, 1).toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })
      const visibleRows = rows
        .filter((item) => item.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()))
        .filter((item) => unitFilter === 'all' || item.unit === unitFilter)
        .filter((item) => categoryFilter === 'all' || item.category === categoryFilter)
        .sort((a, b) => sort === 'default' ? 0 : sort === 'az' ? a.name.localeCompare(b.name) : b.name.localeCompare(a.name))
    
      function updateItemForm(event) {
        const { name, value } = event.target
        setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: value }))
      }
    
      function beginAddItem() {
        setEditingItemNo(null)
        setItemForm(blankItemForm())
        setAddItemOpen(true)
      }
    
      function beginEditItem(item) {
        setEditingItemNo(item.no)
        setItemForm({
          name: item.name || '',
          unit: item.unit || '',
          price: item.price ? item.price.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '') : '',
          dpri: item.dpri ? item.dpri.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '') : '',
          category: item.category || '',
          other: item.other || '',
          expiryDates: String(item.expiry || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean).length
            ? String(item.expiry || '').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(toExpiryDateInput)
            : [''],
          lot: item.lot || '',
          beginning: item.beginning ?? '',
          deliveries: item.deliveries?.length ? item.deliveries.map((delivery) => ({ date: toDateInput(delivery.date || ''), qty: delivery.qty ?? '', vendor: delivery.vendor || '' })) : [blankDelivery()],
          daily: { ...(item.daily || {}) },
          ending: item.ending ?? '',
          monthly: item.monthly ?? '',
          weekly: weeklyRanges.map((_, index) => item.weekly?.[index] ?? 0),
        })
        setAddItemOpen(true)
      }
    
      function updateDelivery(index, key, value) {
        setItemForm((current) => ({
          ...current,
          deliveries: current.deliveries.map((delivery, rowIndex) => rowIndex === index ? { ...delivery, [key]: value } : delivery),
        }))
      }
    
      function updateExpiryDate(index, value) {
        setItemForm((current) => ({
          ...current,
          expiryDates: current.expiryDates.map((expiry, rowIndex) => rowIndex === index ? value : expiry),
        }))
      }
    
      function updateDaily(day, value) {
        setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, daily: { ...current.daily, [day]: value } }))
      }
    
      function addSampleItem(event) {
        event.preventDefault()
        const beginning = Number(itemForm.beginning) || 0
        const deliveries = itemForm.deliveries
          .filter((delivery) => delivery.date || delivery.qty || delivery.vendor.trim())
          .map((delivery) => ({ date: toStockCardDate(delivery.date), qty: Number(delivery.qty) || 0, vendor: delivery.vendor.trim() }))
        const deliveredQty = deliveries.reduce((total, delivery) => total + delivery.qty, 0)
        const newItem = {
          no: editingItemNo ?? Math.max(0, ...rows.map((item) => Number(item.no) || 0)) + 1,
          name: itemForm.name.trim(),
          unit: itemForm.unit.trim(),
          price: itemForm.price ? `\u20B1${Number(itemForm.price).toFixed(2)}` : '',
          dpri: itemForm.dpri ? `\u20B1${Number(itemForm.dpri).toFixed(2)}` : '',
          category: itemForm.category.trim(),
          other: itemForm.other.trim(),
          expiry: itemForm.expiryDates.map((expiry) => toExpiryStockValue(expiry.trim())).filter(Boolean).join('\n'),
          lot: itemForm.lot.trim(),
          beginning,
          deliveries,
          daily: { ...Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(itemForm.daily).map(([day, qty]) => [day, Number(qty) || 0])) },
          ending: itemForm.ending === '' ? beginning + deliveredQty : Number(itemForm.ending) || 0,
          monthly: Number(itemForm.monthly) || 0,
          weekly: itemForm.weekly.map((qty) => Number(qty) || 0),
        }
        if (editingItemNo !== null) {
          setRows((current) => current.map((item) => item.no === editingItemNo ? newItem : item))
        } else {
          setRows((current) => [...current, newItem])
        }
        setSearch('')
        setUnitFilter('all')
        setCategoryFilter('all')
        setSort('default')
        setItemForm(blankItemForm())
        setEditingItemNo(null)
        setAddItemOpen(false)
      }
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content">
          <section className="dashboard-card regular-ledger-card" id="regular">
            <div className="ledger-heading">
              <div><span className="ledger-kicker">E-STOCK / REGULAR</span><h2>Regular inventory</h2><p>Monthly stock card Â· {monthLabel}</p></div>
              <div className="ledger-actions"><span className="sample-indicator"><i /> Sample data</span><MonthYearPicker value={stockMonth} onChange={onStockMonthChange} /></div>
            </div>
            <div className="regular-inventory-actions"><span>Sample only Â· not saved to database</span><div className="regular-toolbar-actions"><ExportEstockButton rows={rows} activeSheet="regular" stockMonth={stockMonth} /><button className="regular-add-item-button" type="button" onClick={beginAddItem}><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12" /></svg>Add item</button></div></div>
            <div className="regular-tools" role="search" aria-label="Filter Regular inventory items">
              <label className="regular-search"><span className="sr-only">Search Items</span><SearchIcon /><input type="search" placeholder="Search Items" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} /></label>
              <label className="regular-select"><span>Unit of Measure</span><select value={unitFilter} onChange={(event) => setUnitFilter(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All units</option>{dropdownOptions.units.map((unit) => <option key={unit} value={unit}>{unit}</option>)}</select></label>
              <label className="regular-select"><span>Category</span><select value={categoryFilter} onChange={(event) => setCategoryFilter(event.target.value)}><option value="all">All categories</option>{dropdownOptions.categories.map((category) => <option key={category} value={category}>{category}</option>)}</select></label>
              <div className="regular-sort"><span>Sort items</span><div><button type="button" className={sort === 'az' ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={sort === 'az'} onClick={() => setSort('az')}>A to Z</button><button type="button" className={sort === 'za' ? 'active' : ''} aria-pressed={sort === 'za'} onClick={() => setSort('za')}>Z to A</button></div></div>
            </div>
            <div className="ledger-hint"><span>â†”</span> Swipe or scroll horizontally to view all stock-card columns</div>
            {visibleRows.length === 0 && <p className="regular-empty-results">No items match your search or filters.</p>}
            <MonthlyStockCard rows={visibleRows} periodLabels={weeklyRanges} regular monthLabel={monthLabel} onItemClick={beginEditItem} />
          </section>
          {addItemOpen && <div className="regular-item-modal-backdrop" role="presentation" onMouseDown={(event) => { if (event.target === event.currentTarget) setAddItemOpen(false) }}>
            <section className="regular-item-modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="regular-add-item-title">
              <div className="regular-item-modal-heading"><div><span className="ledger-kicker">E-STOCK / REGULAR Â· SAMPLE</span><h2 id="regular-add-item-title">{editingItemNo === null ? 'Add item' : 'Edit item'}</h2><p>This preview is not saved to the database.</p></div></div>
              <form className="regular-item-form" onSubmit={addSampleItem}>
                <label className="regular-item-name-field">Item name<input name="name" value={itemForm.name} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="Medicine or supply name" required autoFocus /></label>
                <label>Unit of measure<select name="unit" value={itemForm.unit} onChange={updateItemForm}><option value="">Select a unit</option>{itemForm.unit && !dropdownOptions.units.includes(itemForm.unit) && <option value={itemForm.unit}>{itemForm.unit}</option>}{dropdownOptions.units.map((unit) => <option key={unit} value={unit}>{unit}</option>)}</select></label>
                <label>Unit price<input name="price" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value={itemForm.price} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="0.00" /></label>
                <label>DPRI price<input name="dpri" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value={itemForm.dpri} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="0.00" /></label>
                <label>Category<select name="category" value={itemForm.category} onChange={updateItemForm}><option value="">Select a category</option>{itemForm.category && !dropdownOptions.categories.includes(itemForm.category) && <option value={itemForm.category}>{itemForm.category}</option>}{dropdownOptions.categories.map((category) => <option key={category} value={category}>{category}</option>)}</select></label>
                <label>Other category<select name="other" value={itemForm.other} onChange={updateItemForm}><option value="">Select other category</option>{itemForm.other && !otherCategoryOptions.includes(itemForm.other) && <option value={itemForm.other}>{itemForm.other}</option>}{otherCategoryOptions.map((category) => <option key={category} value={category}>{category}</option>)}</select></label>
                <label>Lot number<input name="lot" value={itemForm.lot} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="Lot number" /></label>
                <label>Beginning balance<input name="beginning" type="number" min="0" step="1" value={itemForm.beginning} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="0" /></label>
                <fieldset className="regular-expiries-fieldset"><legend>Expiry dates</legend><div className="regular-expiries-list">{itemForm.expiryDates.map((expiry, index) => <div className="regular-expiry-fields" key={index}><label><span>{index === 0 ? 'Expiry date' : `Expiry date ${index + 1}`}</span><input type="date" value={expiry} onChange={(event) => updateExpiryDate(index, event.target.value)} /></label>{itemForm.expiryDates.length > 1 && <button type="button" className="regular-remove-delivery" aria-label={`Remove expiry date ${index + 1}`} onClick={() => setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, expiryDates: current.expiryDates.filter((_, rowIndex) => rowIndex !== index) }))}>Remove</button>}</div>)}<button type="button" className="regular-add-delivery" onClick={() => setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, expiryDates: [...current.expiryDates, ''] }))}>+ Add expiry date</button></div></fieldset>
                <fieldset className="regular-deliveries-fieldset"><legend>Deliveries</legend>{itemForm.deliveries.map((delivery, index) => <div className="regular-delivery-fields" key={index}><label>Delivery date<input type="date" value={delivery.date} onChange={(event) => updateDelivery(index, 'date', event.target.value)} /></label><label>Qty delivered<input type="number" min="0" step="1" value={delivery.qty} onChange={(event) => updateDelivery(index, 'qty', event.target.value)} placeholder="0" /></label><label>Supplier<input value={delivery.vendor} onChange={(event) => updateDelivery(index, 'vendor', event.target.value)} placeholder="Supplier name" /></label>{itemForm.deliveries.length > 1 && <button type="button" className="regular-remove-delivery" onClick={() => setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, deliveries: current.deliveries.filter((_, rowIndex) => rowIndex !== index) }))}>Remove</button>}</div>)}<button type="button" className="regular-add-delivery" onClick={() => setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, deliveries: [...current.deliveries, blankDelivery()] }))}>+ Add delivery</button></fieldset>
                <label>Ending balance<input name="ending" type="number" min="0" step="1" value={itemForm.ending} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="Auto-calculate from balance and deliveries" /></label>
                <label>Monthly consumption<input name="monthly" type="number" min="0" step="1" value={itemForm.monthly} onChange={updateItemForm} placeholder="0" /></label>
                <fieldset className="regular-daily-fieldset"><legend>Daily consumption Â· days 1â€“31</legend><div className="regular-daily-grid">{Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, index) => index + 1).map((day) => <label key={day}><span>{day}</span><input aria-label={`Day ${day} consumption`} type="number" min="0" step="1" value={itemForm.daily[day] ?? ''} onChange={(event) => updateDaily(day, event.target.value)} /></label>)}</div></fieldset>
                <fieldset className="regular-weekly-fieldset"><legend>Weekly consumption</legend><div>{weeklyRanges.map((range, index) => <label key={range}>{range}<input type="number" min="0" step="1" value={itemForm.weekly[index]} onChange={(event) => setItemForm((current) => ({ ...current, weekly: current.weekly.map((qty, weeklyIndex) => weeklyIndex === index ? event.target.value : qty) }))} /></label>)}</div></fieldset>
                <div className="regular-item-form-actions"><button type="button" className="regular-stockcards-button" onClick={() => { const selected = rows.find((item) => item.no === editingItemNo) || rows[0]; setAddItemOpen(false); onOpenStockCard?.(selected, stockMonth) }}>Stock Cards</button><button type="button" className="regular-item-cancel" onClick={() => { setAddItemOpen(false); setEditingItemNo(null) }}>Cancel</button><button type="submit" className="regular-add-item-button">{editingItemNo === null ? 'Add sample item' : 'Save sample changes'}</button></div>
              </form>
            </section>
          </div>}
        </div>
      )
    }
    
    function SearchIcon() {
      return <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8.7" cy="8.7" r="5.7" /><path d="m13 13 4 4" /></svg>
    }
    import { useState } from 'react'
    import MonthYearPicker from '../components/MonthYearPicker.jsx'
    import MonthlyStockCard from '../components/MonthlyStockCard.jsx'
    import ExportEstockButton from '../components/ExportEstockButton.jsx'
    import './DonationInventory.css'
    export const sampleDonationRows = [
      { no: 1, name: 'Aciclovir 250mg vial', unit: 'vial', category: 'Donation', expiry: '', lot: '', beginning: 0, deliveries: [], daily: {}, ending: 0, monthly: 0, weekly: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0] },
      { no: 2, name: 'Amikacin 125mg/ml vial', unit: 'vial', category: 'Donation', expiry: '', lot: '', beginning: 0, deliveries: [{ date: '9/4/2026', qty: 68, vendor: 'PGH' }], daily: {}, ending: 0, monthly: 0, weekly: [0, 0, 0, 0, 0] },
      { no: 4, name: 'Amino Acid 7%', unit: 'bottle', category: 'Donation', expiry: '12/2026', lot: '2250117', beginning: 10, deliveries: [{ date: '10/14/2026', qty: 20, vendor: 'VMC' }], daily: { 1: 1, 3: 4, 4: 5 }, ending: 0, monthly: 10, weekly: [10, 0, 0, 0, 0] },
      { no: 5, name: '5% Amino Acids in 5% Sorbitol', unit: 'bottle', category: 'Donation', expiry: '', lot: '', beginning: 0, deliveries: [], daily: { 4: 1 }, ending: -1, monthly: 1, weekly: [1, 0, 0, 0, 0] },
      { no: 16, name: 'Azithromycin 500mg vial', unit: 'vial', category: 'Donation', expiry: '01/2027', lot: 'R45240151', beginning: 397, deliveries: [{ date: '7/16/2026', qty: 600, vendor: 'CONRADO' }], daily: { 1: 1, 4: 4 }, ending: 392, monthly: 5, weekly: [5, 0, 0, 0, 0] },
    ]
    const donationWeeklyRanges = ['1-3', '4-10', '11-17', '18-24', '25-30']
    
    export default function DonationInventory({ stockMonth, onStockMonthChange, monthLabel }) {
      const [search, setSearch] = useState('')
      const visibleRows = sampleDonationRows.filter((item) =>
        item.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(search.trim().toLocaleLowerCase()),
      )
    
      return (
        <div className="section-page-content donation-inventory-page">
          <section className="dashboard-card regular-ledger-card" id="donation">
            <div className="ledger-heading">
              <div><span className="ledger-kicker">E-STOCK / DONATION</span><h2>Donation inventory</h2><p>Monthly stock card Â· {monthLabel}</p></div>
              <div className="ledger-actions"><span className="sample-indicator"><i /> Sample data</span><MonthYearPicker value={stockMonth} onChange={onStockMonthChange} /></div>
            </div>
            <div className="regular-inventory-actions"><span>Sample data Â· workbook export</span><ExportEstockButton rows={sampleDonationRows} activeSheet="donation" stockMonth={stockMonth} /></div>
            <div className="regular-tools donation-search-tools" role="search" aria-label="Search Donation inventory items">
              <label className="regular-search"><span className="sr-only">Search Items</span><SearchIcon /><input type="search" placeholder="Search Items" value={search} onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)} /></label>
            </div>
            <div className="ledger-hint"><span>â†”</span> Swipe or scroll horizontally to view all stock-card columns</div>
            {visibleRows.length === 0 && <p className="regular-empty-results">No items match your search.</p>}
            <MonthlyStockCard rows={visibleRows} periodLabels={donationWeeklyRanges} monthLabel={monthLabel} />
          </section>
        </div>
      )
    }
    
    function SearchIcon() {
      return <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8.7" cy="8.7" r="5.7" /><path d="m13 13 4 4" /></svg>
    }
    .regular-tools { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(190px, 1.35fr) minmax(145px, .8fr) minmax(180px, 1fr) auto; align-items: end; gap: 10px; padding: 13px 18px; border-top: 1px solid #edf1ee; background: #fff; }
    .regular-search, .regular-select { min-width: 0; height: 36px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #dfe7e2; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #75847b; }
    .regular-search:focus-within, .regular-select:focus-within { border-color: #8db49a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(76, 137, 96, .1); }
    .regular-search svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex: 0 0 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 1.7; }
    .regular-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #344a3b; font: inherit; font-size: 11px; }
    .regular-search input::placeholder { color: #98a49c; }
    .regular-search input::-webkit-search-cancel-button { cursor: pointer; }
    .regular-select { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; align-content: center; gap: 2px; padding: 3px 0; }
    .regular-select > span { margin-left: 10px; }
    .regular-select > span, .regular-sort > span { color: #8a968e; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .regular-select select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0 26px 0 10px; overflow: hidden; border: 0; outline: 0; appearance: none; background: transparent; color: #405449; font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; text-overflow: ellipsis; cursor: pointer; }
    .regular-select::after { position: absolute; right: 11px; bottom: 10px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-right: 1px solid #74877a; border-bottom: 1px solid #74877a; content: ''; pointer-events: none; transform: rotate(45deg); }
    .regular-sort { display: grid; gap: 5px; }
    .regular-sort > div { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
    .regular-sort button { height: 36px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #dfe7e2; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #64756a; font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; cursor: pointer; }
    .regular-sort button:hover { border-color: #bfd4c5; background: #f8fbf8; }
    .regular-sort button.active { border-color: #b9d5c1; background: #edf6ef; color: #236342; font-weight: 700; }
    .regular-empty-results { margin: 0; padding: 18px; border-top: 1px solid #edf1ee; color: #78877e; font-size: 11px; text-align: center; }
    .regular-inventory-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 18px; border-top: 1px solid #edf1ee; background: #fbfcfb; color: #87938b; font-size: 10px; }
    .regular-toolbar-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .regular-export-button { min-height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #cddfd2; border-radius: 7px; background: #fff; color: #286345; font: inherit; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
    .regular-export-button:hover { background: #f1f7f2; border-color: #a9c8b2; }
    .regular-export-button svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; }
    .regular-add-item-button { min-height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #176345; border-radius: 7px; background: #176345; color: #fff; font: inherit; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; }
    .regular-add-item-button:hover { background: #104e35; }
